# Single-function classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def classify_function(
    name: str,
    language: str = UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE,
    *,
    is_library: bool = False,
    is_thunk: bool = False,
    segment_name: Optional[str] = None,
    author_prefixes: Sequence[str] = (),
    third_party_crates: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset(),
    referenced_strings: Sequence[str] = (),
) -> FunctionOrigin:
    """Origin of one function. Name rules first, IDA flags second, string hints last."""
    text = (name or "").strip()
    if is_thunk:
        return FunctionOrigin(THUNK, "", "IDA thunk")
    if text in AUTHOR_ROOT_NAMES:
        return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, "main", "program entry routine")

    if language == GO or go_package(text) in ("runtime", "main") or text.startswith(("runtime.", "runtime_")):
        origin = _classify_go(text, author_prefixes)
        if origin is not None:
            return origin
    if language == RUST or text.startswith(("_ZN", "__ZN", "_R")) or "::" in text:
        origin = _classify_rust(text, author_prefixes, third_party_crates)
        if origin is not None:
            return origin
    if language == DELPHI:
        origin = _classify_delphi(text)
        if origin is not None:
            return origin
    if language == NIM:
        origin = _classify_nim(text)
        if origin is not None:
            return origin
    if language == DOTNET and _DOTNET_FRAMEWORK_RE.match(text):
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, text.split(".", 1)[0], ".NET framework namespace")

    origin = _classify_native(text)
    if origin is not None:
        return origin

    if is_library:
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB if language != UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE else THIRD_PARTY, "", "IDA library (FLIRT) signature")

    hint = _string_hint(referenced_strings, language)
    if hint is not None:
        return hint
    return FunctionOrigin(UNKNOWN, "", "not recognised as library code")


def _classify_go(text: str, author_prefixes: Sequence[str]) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    if text in _GO_COMPILER_NAMES or text.startswith(_GO_COMPILER_PREFIXES):
        return FunctionOrigin(COMPILER, "", "Go compiler-generated helper")
    if text.endswith(("-fm", ".deferwrap1", ".gowrap1", ".stkobj")) and text.startswith(("runtime", "internal", "sync", "reflect")):
        return FunctionOrigin(COMPILER, "", "Go compiler wrapper")
    package = go_package(text)
    if not package:
        return None
    root = package.split("/", 1)[0]
    for prefix in author_prefixes:
        if prefix and (package == prefix or package.startswith(prefix + "/") or package.split("/", 1)[0] == prefix):
            if prefix != "main" or package == "main":
                return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, package, "Go author package")
    if package == "main":
        return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, package, "Go main package")
    if package in GO_RUNTIME_ROOTS or root in ("runtime", "internal") or package.startswith(("runtime/", "internal/", "vendor/")):
        return FunctionOrigin(RUNTIME, package, "Go runtime")
    if root in GO_STD_ROOTS:
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, package, "Go standard library")
    if "." in root:
        return FunctionOrigin(THIRD_PARTY, go_module_root(package), "Go third-party module")
    # A dot-less package that is not std is a package of the main module.
    return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, package, "Go package of the main module")


def _classify_rust(text: str, author_prefixes: Sequence[str], third_party: FrozenSet[str]) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    crate = rust_crate(text)
    if not crate:
        return None
    if crate in RUST_RUNTIME_CRATES:
        return FunctionOrigin(RUNTIME if crate in ("core", "alloc", "std") else COMPILER, crate, "Rust runtime crate")
    if crate in RUST_STD_CRATES:
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, crate, "Rust standard support crate")
    if crate in third_party:
        return FunctionOrigin(THIRD_PARTY, crate, "Rust crate from the Cargo registry")
    if crate in author_prefixes:
        return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, crate, "Rust author crate")
    if crate in _KNOWN_RUST_THIRD_PARTY:
        return FunctionOrigin(THIRD_PARTY, crate, "well-known Rust crate")
    return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, crate, "Rust crate not from the standard library or registry")


_KNOWN_RUST_THIRD_PARTY: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset(
    """
    tokio mio futures futures_util futures_core reqwest hyper h2 http httparse rustls ring webpki serde serde_json
    regex regex_syntax regex_automata aho_corasick bytes base64 rand rand_core rand_chacha chrono time log env_logger
    tracing winapi windows windows_sys ntapi sysinfo clap url idna percent_encoding encoding_rs smallvec parking_lot
    once_cell lazy_static crossbeam crossbeam_channel crossbeam_utils rayon rayon_core zip flate2 aes aes_gcm cipher
    chacha20 chacha20poly1305 sha2 sha1 md5 digest generic_array block_buffer hmac pbkdf2 rusqlite libsqlite3_sys
    screenshots xcap image png jpeg_decoder obfstr litcrypt goldberg dirs dirs_sys whoami hex anyhow thiserror
    """.split()
)


def _classify_delphi(text: str) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    unit = delphi_unit(text)
    if not unit:
        if text.startswith(("@", "System")):
            return FunctionOrigin(RUNTIME, "System", "Delphi RTL helper")
        return None
    head = unit.split(".", 1)[0].lower()
    lowered = unit.lower()
    if head in ("system", "sysinit"):
        return FunctionOrigin(RUNTIME, unit, "Delphi System/SysInit unit")
    if head in DELPHI_RTL_UNITS or lowered in DELPHI_RTL_UNITS:
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, unit, "Delphi RTL/VCL/FMX unit")
    if lowered.startswith(DELPHI_THIRD_PARTY_PREFIXES) and not lowered.startswith(("unit", "main", "form")):
        # "IdHTTP", "IdSSLOpenSSL", "JclSysInfo", "SynCrypto" ...
        if re.match(r"^(?:id|jcl|jv|dcp|syn|blcksock|ssl_openssl|superobject|zip)[A-Z_]?", unit, re.IGNORECASE):
            return FunctionOrigin(THIRD_PARTY, unit, "Delphi third-party component library")
    return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, unit, "Delphi project unit")


def _classify_nim(text: str) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    if _NIM_RUNTIME_RE.match(text):
        return FunctionOrigin(RUNTIME, "system", "Nim runtime")
    match = _NIM_MANGLED_RE.search(text)
    if not match:
        return None
    module = match.group("module").lower()
    if module in NIM_STD_MODULES or module.startswith(("std", "pure", "system")):
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, module, "Nim standard library module")
    return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, module, "Nim project module")


def _classify_native(text: str) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    if not text or is_auto_named(text):
        return None
    if _CRT_RE.search(text):
        return FunctionOrigin(COMPILER, "crt", "C/C++ runtime or compiler helper")
    if _CPP_STDLIB_RE.match(text):
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB, "c++ std", "C++ standard library")
    if _CPP_THIRD_PARTY_RE.match(text):
        return FunctionOrigin(THIRD_PARTY, _native_library_label(text), "statically linked C/C++ library")
    return None


def _native_library_label(text: str) -> str:
    head = re.split(r"::|_", text, maxsplit=1)[0]
    return head.lower() if head else "native library"


def _string_hint(referenced: Sequence[str], language: str) -> Optional[FunctionOrigin]:
    """Panic/assert source paths tell library code from project code in stripped binaries."""
    library_hits = 0
    author_hits = 0
    for value in referenced:
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            continue
        if _RUSTC_LIB_RE.search(value) or _CARGO_CRATE_RE.search(value) or _CARGO_GIT_RE.search(value):
            library_hits += 1
        elif re.search(r"(?i)[\\/](?:go[\\/]src|golang[\\/]src|pkg[\\/]mod)[\\/]", value):
            library_hits += 1
        elif re.search(r"(?i)\b(?:src[\\/](?:main|lib|bin)[\\/]?|[\w\-]+\.(?:rs|go|nim|pas|dpr))\b", value) and "cargo" not in value.lower():
            author_hits += 1
    if library_hits and not author_hits:
        return FunctionOrigin(STDLIB if language != UNKNOWN_LANGUAGE else THIRD_PARTY, "", "references library source paths")
    if author_hits and not library_hits:
        return FunctionOrigin(AUTHOR, "", "references project source paths")
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Whole-inventory index
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class InventoryEntry:
    """Minimal facts needed to classify one function (cheap to collect for every function)."""

    address: int
    name: str
    is_library: bool = False
    is_thunk: bool = False
    segment_name: Optional[str] = None
    callees: Tuple[int, ...] = ()
    referenced_strings: Tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class OriginIndex:
    language: LanguageGuess
    origins: Mapping[int, FunctionOrigin]
    counts: Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...]
    third_party_libraries: Tuple[Tuple[str, int], ...]
    author_roots: Tuple[int, ...]
    total: int
    notes: Tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def origin_of(self, address: int) -> str:
        item = self.origins.get(address)
        return item.origin if item is not None else UNKNOWN

    def is_author(self, address: int) -> bool:
        return self.origin_of(address) in ANALYSABLE_ORIGINS

    @property
    def author_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(count for origin, count in self.counts if origin in ANALYSABLE_ORIGINS)

    @property
    def named_author_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for item in self.origins.values() if item.origin == AUTHOR)

    @property
    def library_ratio(self) -> float:
        return (1.0 - self.author_count / float(self.total)) if self.total else 0.0


def build_origin_index(
    entries: Sequence[InventoryEntry],
    strings: Iterable[str] = (),
    segment_names: Iterable[str] = (),
    import_dlls: Iterable[str] = (),
    language: Optional[LanguageGuess] = None,
) -> OriginIndex:
    """Classify every function, then apply the structural fallback for unnamed ones.

    Structural fallback: an auto-named (``sub_``) function whose callers are all
    library/runtime code, and that only calls library/runtime code (or nothing),
    is library code too. This recovers stripped static libraries (OpenSSL,
    zlib, Rust std helpers) without misclassifying the author's helpers, which
    are reached from author code.
    """
    string_list = [value for value in strings if isinstance(value, str)]
    guess = language or detect_language((item.name for item in entries), string_list, segment_names, import_dlls)
    third_party_crates = rust_third_party_crates(string_list) if guess.language == RUST else frozenset()
    origins: Dict[int, FunctionOrigin] = {}
    for item in entries:
        origins[item.address] = classify_function(
            item.name,
            guess.language,
            is_library=item.is_library,
            is_thunk=item.is_thunk,
            segment_name=item.segment_name,
            author_prefixes=guess.author_prefixes,
            third_party_crates=third_party_crates,
            referenced_strings=item.referenced_strings,
        )

    notes: List[str] = []
    callers: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
    for item in entries:
        for callee in item.callees:
            if callee != item.address:
                callers.setdefault(callee, []).append(item.address)
    by_address = {item.address: item for item in entries}
    changed = True
    rounds = 0
    inferred = 0
    while changed and rounds < 4:
        changed = False
        rounds += 1
        for address, origin in list(origins.items()):
            if origin.origin != UNKNOWN or not is_auto_named(by_address[address].name):
                continue
            incoming = callers.get(address, ())
            if not incoming:
                continue
            if any(origins.get(caller, FunctionOrigin(UNKNOWN)).origin in ANALYSABLE_ORIGINS for caller in incoming):
                continue
            outgoing = [callee for callee in by_address[address].callees if callee in origins]
            if any(origins[callee].origin in ANALYSABLE_ORIGINS for callee in outgoing):
                continue
            donor = origins[incoming[0]]
            origins[address] = FunctionOrigin(
                donor.origin if donor.origin != THUNK else STDLIB, donor.package, "only reached from library code"
            )
            inferred += 1
            changed = True
    if inferred:
        notes.append("{0} unnamed function(s) reached only from library code were classified as library".format(inferred))

    counts: Dict[str, int] = {origin: 0 for origin in ORIGINS}
    libraries: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for origin in origins.values():
        counts[origin.origin] = counts.get(origin.origin, 0) + 1
        if origin.origin == THIRD_PARTY and origin.package:
            libraries[origin.package] = libraries.get(origin.package, 0) + 1

    roots = _author_roots(entries, origins)
    if not any(origin.origin == AUTHOR for origin in origins.values()) and guess.language in STATIC_RUNTIME_LANGUAGES:
        notes.append(
            "no named author functions were recovered for a {0} binary; symbols may be stripped or obfuscated "
            "(e.g. garble) - unnamed functions are kept for analysis".format(guess.language)
        )
    return OriginIndex(
        language=guess,
        origins=origins,
        counts=tuple((origin, counts.get(origin, 0)) for origin in ORIGINS),
        third_party_libraries=tuple(sorted(libraries.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))),
        author_roots=roots,
        total=len(entries),
        notes=tuple(notes),
    )


def _author_roots(entries: Sequence[InventoryEntry], origins: Mapping[int, FunctionOrigin]) -> Tuple[int, ...]:
    """Language-level entry routines of author code (``main.main``, ``DllMain``, Delphi/Nim main modules)."""
    roots: List[int] = []
    for item in entries:
        if item.name in AUTHOR_ROOT_NAMES or item.name.endswith(("::main", "4main17h", "main.main")):
            roots.append(item.address)
        elif re.match(r"^_ZN\d+[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*4main17h[0-9a-f]{16}E$", item.name) and origins.get(item.address, FunctionOrigin(UNKNOWN)).origin == AUTHOR:
            roots.append(item.address)
    return tuple(sorted(dict.fromkeys(roots)))


def format_origin_table(index: OriginIndex) -> str:
    """Compact text table for the Triage/Report tabs."""
    lines = [
        "Code origin ({0}, confidence {1:.0%}): {2} functions".format(
            index.language.language, index.language.confidence, index.total
        )
    ]
    for origin, count in index.counts:
        if not count:
            continue
        share = count / float(index.total) if index.total else 0.0
        lines.append("  {0:<34} {1:>7}  {2:>5.1%}".format(ORIGIN_LABELS.get(origin, origin), count, share))
    if index.third_party_libraries:
        shown = ", ".join("{0} ({1})".format(name, count) for name, count in index.third_party_libraries[:12])
        more = " +{0} more".format(len(index.third_party_libraries) - 12) if len(index.third_party_libraries) > 12 else ""
        lines.append("  third-party: " + shown + more)
    if index.language.evidence:
        lines.append("  language evidence: " + "; ".join(index.language.evidence[:3]))
    for note in index.notes:
        lines.append("  note: " + note)
    return "\n".join(lines)

1	"""Token-efficient whole-binary sweep: plan, batched model requests, early stop, synthesis.
2	
3	```text
4	plan_sweep   (local)  DFS over the call graph from the entry functions, noise and
5	                      zero-score functions pruned, cap max_functions, then semantic
6	                      batching with a representation level per function
7	run_sweep    (model)  ONE request per batch with a batched schema, strict parsing,
8	                      api_catalog cross-check, SweepState + early-stop policy after
9	                      every batch, token budget charged per request
10	synthesize_sweep      SessionFacts built from the sweep -> one synthesis call reusing
11	                      analysis/investigation.py -> InvestigationResult + SweepSummary
12	```
13	
14	Nothing here touches IDA: ``collect_context`` is injected by the controller
15	and runs on IDA's thread; nothing here writes. Suggested names come back as
16	plain strings; the controller turns them into PENDING proposals.
17	"""
18	
19	from __future__ import annotations
20	
21	import json
22	import re
23	from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
24	from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, FrozenSet, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Set, Tuple
25	
26	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.api_catalog import CATEGORIES, canonical_api_name, lookup_api
27	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.callflow import AnalysisStep, CallFlow
28	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.capabilities import BASES, _allowed_addresses, _evidence_address_ok, _known_api_tokens
29	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.function import FunctionAnalysis, load_prompt
30	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.investigation import (
31	    InvestigationResult,
32	    SessionFacts,
33	    VisitedFunction,
34	    synthesize_from_facts,
35	)
36	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.iocs import INDICATOR_KINDS
37	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import CATEGORY_WEIGHTS, FunctionScore
38	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.verdict import WEIGHTS, VerdictBand, band_for
39	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.budget import TokenBudget, format_tokens
40	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.context import FunctionAnalysisContext
41	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.parsing import strip_json_fence
42	from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.llm.base import LLMProvider, LLMRequest
43	
44	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
45	# Policy constants
46	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
47	
48	LEVELS: Tuple[str, ...] = ("full", "compact")
49	# Context sections collected per representation level (ida/context.py selectors).
50	SECTIONS_BY_LEVEL: Dict[str, FrozenSet[str]] = {
51	    "full": frozenset({"assembly", "callers", "callees", "strings", "pseudocode", "referenced_names", "signature"}),
52	    "compact": frozenset({"callers", "callees", "strings", "referenced_names", "signature"}),
53	}
54	SMALL_FUNCTION_INSTRUCTIONS = 60
55	DEFAULT_HIGH_SCORE_THRESHOLD = 15
56	DEFAULT_BATCH_TOKENS = 6000
57	MIN_BATCH_TOKENS = 500
58	MAX_BATCH_FUNCTIONS = 8
59	# Representation cost estimates (tokens) used only for planning.
60	FULL_BASE_TOKENS = 350
61	FULL_PER_INSTRUCTION_TOKENS = 10
62	COMPACT_BASE_TOKENS = 120
63	COMPACT_PER_REFERENCE_TOKENS = 6
64	REQUEST_OVERHEAD_TOKENS = 250
65	# Early-stop policy defaults.
66	EARLY_STOP_MIN_CATEGORIES = 2
67	EARLY_STOP_STRONG_CONFIDENCE = 0.7
68	# "Concrete" findings are the only thing that may end a sweep early: observed basis,
69	# high confidence, at least two evidence lines carrying addresses, and at least one
70	# catalogue API named in that evidence that the function really references.

"""Token-efficient whole-binary sweep: plan, batched model requests, early stop, synthesis.

```text
plan_sweep   (local)  DFS over the call graph from the entry functions, noise and
                      zero-score functions pruned, cap max_functions, then semantic
                      batching with a representation level per function
run_sweep    (model)  ONE request per batch with a batched schema, strict parsing,
                      api_catalog cross-check, SweepState + early-stop policy after
                      every batch, token budget charged per request
synthesize_sweep      SessionFacts built from the sweep -> one synthesis call reusing
                      analysis/investigation.py -> InvestigationResult + SweepSummary
```

Nothing here touches IDA: ``collect_context`` is injected by the controller
and runs on IDA's thread; nothing here writes. Suggested names come back as
plain strings; the controller turns them into PENDING proposals.
"""

def dominant_category(categories: Sequence[str]) -> Optional[str]:
    """The highest-weighted triage category of a function, or ``None``."""
    if not categories:
        return None
    return max(categories, key=lambda name: (CATEGORY_WEIGHTS.get(name, 0), -categories.index(name)))


def estimate_item_tokens(level: str, instruction_count: int, reference_count: int = 8) -> int:
    if level == "full":
        return FULL_BASE_TOKENS + FULL_PER_INSTRUCTION_TOKENS * max(0, min(instruction_count, MAX_ASSEMBLY_LINES))
    return COMPACT_BASE_TOKENS + COMPACT_PER_REFERENCE_TOKENS * max(0, min(reference_count, 2 * MAX_REFERENCES_PER_FUNCTION))


def plan_sweep(
    ranked: Sequence[FunctionScore],
    flows: Sequence[CallFlow],
    path: Sequence[AnalysisStep],
    adjacency: Mapping[int, Sequence[int]],
    noise: Callable[[int], bool],
    max_functions: int,
    budget: Optional[TokenBudget] = None,
    names: Optional[Mapping[int, str]] = None,
    instruction_counts: Optional[Mapping[int, int]] = None,
    entries: Sequence[int] = (),
    batch_token_budget: int = DEFAULT_BATCH_TOKENS,
    high_score_threshold: int = DEFAULT_HIGH_SCORE_THRESHOLD,
    system_tokens: int = 0,
) -> SweepPlan:
    """Plan which functions to analyse, in which order, at which representation, in which batches.

    * DFS from the entry functions (``entries``, else the flows' entries, else
      the ranked functions), children in descending local score.
    * Noise functions are never analysed; the walk passes through them only
      when they lie on a suspicious flow. Non-noise functions with score <= 0
      are pruned unless they lie on a suspicious flow.
    * At most ``max_functions`` functions. Ranked / path functions the DFS did
      not reach (callbacks, indirect calls) are appended while room remains.
    * Representation: ``full`` for score >= ``high_score_threshold`` or for a
      frame on a suspicious flow leading to such a function (the orchestrators),
      ``compact`` otherwise.
    * Batching: a small parent (<= 60 instructions) shares a request with its
      small direct non-noise callees of the same dominant category; remaining
      single compact functions are packed together; every batch stays within
      ``batch_token_budget`` (and ``budget.remaining`` when the budget is bounded).
    """
    if isinstance(max_functions, bool) or not isinstance(max_functions, int) or max_functions < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_functions must be a positive integer")
    if isinstance(batch_token_budget, bool) or not isinstance(batch_token_budget, int) or batch_token_budget < MIN_BATCH_TOKENS:
        raise ValueError("batch_token_budget must be an integer of at least {0}".format(MIN_BATCH_TOKENS))
    if budget is not None and budget.remaining is not None:
        batch_token_budget = max(MIN_BATCH_TOKENS, min(batch_token_budget, budget.remaining))

    scores: Dict[int, FunctionScore] = {item.address: item for item in ranked}
    known_names: Dict[int, str] = dict(names or {})
    for item in ranked:
        known_names.setdefault(item.address, item.name)
    for step in path:
        known_names.setdefault(step.address, step.name)
    counts = instruction_counts or {}

    def count_of(address: int) -> int:
        value = counts.get(address)
        if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0:
            return value
        score = scores.get(address)
        return max(0, score.size // 4) if score is not None else 0

    def score_of(address: int) -> int:
        score = scores.get(address)
        return score.score if score is not None else 0

    # ``on_flow``: every frame of a flow that was actually reached from an entry (a flow without a
    # path only names its target). ``high_flow``: frames on the way to a high-score target, which
    # get the full representation because they orchestrate the interesting code.
    on_flow: Set[int] = set()
    high_flow: Set[int] = set()
    for flow in flows:
        for address, name in flow.callers:
            known_names.setdefault(address, name)
        if not flow.reached_from_entry:
            known_names.setdefault(flow.target, flow.target_name)
            continue
        frames = flow.full_path or flow.path or ((flow.target, flow.target_name),)
        for address, name in frames:
            on_flow.add(address)
            known_names.setdefault(address, name)
        if score_of(flow.target) >= high_score_threshold:
            high_flow.update(address for address, _name in frames)

    roots: List[int] = []
    for address in list(entries) + [flow.entry for flow in flows if flow.entry is not None]:
        if address not in roots:
            roots.append(address)
    if not roots:
        roots = [item.address for item in ranked if not noise(item.address)]

    order: List[Tuple[int, Optional[int], int]] = []  # (address, parent, depth)
    chosen: Set[int] = set()
    seen: Set[int] = set()
    pruned_noise: Set[int] = set()
    pruned_low: Set[int] = set()
    truncated = False
    stack: List[Tuple[int, Optional[int], int]] = [(root, None, 0) for root in reversed(roots)]
    while stack and not truncated:
        address, parent, depth = stack.pop()
        if address in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(address)
        is_noise = bool(noise(address))
        descend = False
        if is_noise:
            pruned_noise.add(address)
            descend = address in on_flow
        elif score_of(address) <= 0 and address not in on_flow:
            pruned_low.add(address)
        else:
            if len(order) >= max_functions:
                truncated = True
                break
            order.append((address, parent, depth))
            chosen.add(address)
            descend = True
        if descend:
            children = [child for child in adjacency.get(address, ()) if child != address and child not in seen]
            children.sort(key=lambda child: (-score_of(child), child))
            for child in reversed(children):
                stack.append((child, address if not is_noise else parent, depth + 1))

    # Functions the DFS could not reach (callbacks, indirect calls): path order first, then ranking.
    for address in [step.address for step in path] + [item.address for item in ranked]:
        if len(order) >= max_functions:
            if address not in chosen:
                truncated = True
            break

    if modules.idautils is None or not callable(getattr(modules.idautils, "Functions", None)):
        return (), False, False, None
    inventory: List[Tuple[int, object, str, bool, bool, Optional[str]]] = []
    inventory_truncated = False
    funcs = modules.funcs

                referenced_strings=detailed[address].referenced_strings if address in detailed else (),
            )

"""Language-independent behaviour signals: author function names, strings, capability libraries.

The import-table rules in ``triage``/``verdict`` see nothing in Go, Rust,
Delphi or Nim binaries, which call Windows through their own runtime. What
those binaries *do* expose is (a) recovered symbol names of the author's
functions (``main.getChromeLogins``), (b) high-signal strings (browser
profile paths, wallet extension IDs, ransom-note phrases) and (c) the
third-party libraries they link (screenshot, keyboard-hook, blockchain C2,
C2-framework modules). This module turns those into categorised, addressed
hits. It is pure Python and deterministic.

Name hits are only ever computed for *author* functions (see
``analysis/code_origin``); the verdict additionally requires corroboration
before it scores a behaviour, so ordinary software with functions called
``Install`` or ``Download`` is not flagged.

# Categories
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

C2 = "c2"

RANSOMWARE = "ransomware"
DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE = "download_execute"
CRYPTO_MINING = "crypto_mining"
HACKTOOL = "hacktool"
PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK = "pup_browser_hijack"
PUP_ADWARE = "pup_adware"

    {CREDENTIAL_THEFT, KEYLOGGING, SURVEILLANCE, REMOTE_CONTROL, C2, INJECTION, EVASION, PRIVILEGE, RANSOMWARE,
     DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE, CRYPTO_MINING, HACKTOOL, PERSISTENCE}
)

    CREDENTIAL_THEFT: "credential / data theft",
    KEYLOGGING: "keylogging / clipboard capture",
    SURVEILLANCE: "screen, webcam or microphone capture",
    REMOTE_CONTROL: "remote shell / RAT command handling",
    C2: "command-and-control / exfiltration",
    PERSISTENCE: "persistence / self-install",
    INJECTION: "code injection / in-memory loading",
    EVASION: "anti-analysis / defence evasion / self-deletion",
    PRIVILEGE: "privilege escalation / token theft",
    RANSOMWARE: "file encryption / ransomware",
    DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE: "download and execute / dropper",
    CRYPTO_MINING: "crypto-currency mining",
    HACKTOOL: "offensive framework / hacktool",
    PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK: "browser settings hijack",
    PUP_ADWARE: "adware / bundled offers",
    CONFIG_DECODING: "string / config decryption",
}

# Weights used by the triage ranking (per function) - the verdict has its own table.
NAME_TRIAGE_WEIGHTS: Dict[str, int] = {
    CREDENTIAL_THEFT: 12, KEYLOGGING: 10, SURVEILLANCE: 8, REMOTE_CONTROL: 9, C2: 8, PERSISTENCE: 7, INJECTION: 12,
    EVASION: 7, PRIVILEGE: 8, RANSOMWARE: 12, DOWNLOAD_EXECUTE: 7, CRYPTO_MINING: 10, HACKTOOL: 12,

    (CRYPTO_MINING, re.compile(r"\b(?:miner\w*|xmrig|stratum\w*|hash\s?rate|start\s?mining|mining\s?\w*)\b")),
    (HACKTOOL, re.compile(r"\b(?:mimikatz|sekurlsa|kerberoast\w*|beacon\s?object|bof\s?load\w*|execute\s?assembly|meterpreter|sliver\w*)\b")),
    (PUP_BROWSER_HIJACK, re.compile(r"\b(?:search\s?(?:hijack|provider|engine)|set\s?homepage|home\s?page|secure\s?preferences|super\s?mac|force\s?install\s?extension|install\s?extension|new\s?tab\s?override)\b")),

_CAMEL_RE = re.compile(r"(?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z])")
_SPLIT_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+")
_AUTO_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:sub|loc|nullsub|j_sub|unknown_libname)_[0-9A-Fa-f]+$")


def name_tokens(name: str) -> str:
    """``main.(*wsSess).recvWss`` -> ``main ws sess recv wss``; ``GetChromeLogins`` -> ``get chrome logins``."""
    text = name or ""
    # Keep the method part of Go/Rust/C++ qualified names; packages add little.
    for separator in ("::", "."):
        if separator in text:
            parts = [part for part in text.split(separator) if part]
            if len(parts) > 1:
                text = " ".join(parts[-2:])
    text = _CAMEL_RE.sub(" ", text)
    return " ".join(part.lower() for part in _SPLIT_RE.split(text) if part)

    if not tokens:
        return ()

    hits: List[str] = []
    for category, pattern in _NAME_RULES:
        if pattern.search(tokens) or pattern.search(joined):
            hits.append(category)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(hits))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StringHit:
    category: str
    group: str
    address: int
    text: str


def classify_strings(strings: Iterable[Tuple[int, str]], limit_per_group: int = 6) -> Tuple[StringHit, ...]:
    """Categorised high-signal strings (``(address, text)`` pairs in, addressed hits out)."""
    counts: Dict[Tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    output: List[StringHit] = []
    for address, text in strings:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) < 4:
            continue
        lowered = text.lower()
        for category, group, needles in _STRING_RULES:
            key = (category, group)
            if counts.get(key, 0) >= limit_per_group:
                continue
            if any(needle in lowered for needle in needles):
                counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
                output.append(StringHit(category, group, address, text if len(text) <= 120 else text[:117] + "..."))
    return tuple(output)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LibraryHit:
    library: str
    category: str
    label: str
    strong: bool
    functions: int


def classify_libraries(libraries: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]]) -> Tuple[LibraryHit, ...]:
    output: List[LibraryHit] = []
    for library, count in libraries:
        lowered = library.lower()
        for needle, category, label, strong in _LIBRARY_RULES:
            if needle in lowered:
                output.append(LibraryHit(library, category, label, strong, count))
                break
    return tuple(output)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-function aggregation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NameHit:
    address: int
    name: str
    categories: Tuple[str, ...]


def author_name_hits(functions: Iterable[object], is_author) -> Tuple[NameHit, ...]:
    """Name-derived behaviour of every author function (``is_author(summary) -> bool``)."""
    output: List[NameHit] = []
    for item in functions:
        if not is_author(item):
            continue
        name = str(getattr(item, "name", "") or "")
        categories = classify_name(name)
        if categories:
            output.append(NameHit(int(getattr(item, "address", 0)), name, categories))
    return tuple(output)


def group_name_hits(hits: Sequence[NameHit]) -> Dict[str, List[NameHit]]:
    grouped: Dict[str, List[NameHit]] = {}
    for hit in hits:
        for category in hit.categories:
            grouped.setdefault(category, []).append(hit)
    return grouped

    output: List[LibraryHit] = []

    """Name-derived behaviour of every author function (``is_author(summary) -> bool``)."""
    output: List[NameHit] = []
    for item in functions:
        if not is_author(item):

        name = str(getattr(item, "name", "") or "")
        categories = classify_name(name)
        if categories:
            output.append(NameHit(int(getattr(item, "address", 0)), name, categories))
    return tuple(output)

    grouped: Dict[str, List[NameHit]] = {}
    for hit in hits:

            grouped.setdefault(category, []).append(hit)
    return grouped

def name_tokens(name: str) -> str:
    """``main.(*wsSess).recvWss`` -> ``main ws sess recv wss``; ``GetChromeLogins`` -> ``get chrome logins``."""
    text = name or ""
    # Keep the method part of Go/Rust/C++ qualified names; packages add little.
    for separator in ("::", "."):
        if separator in text:
            parts = [part for part in text.split(separator) if part]
            if len(parts) > 1:
                text = " ".join(parts[-2:])
    text = _CAMEL_RE.sub(" ", text)
    return " ".join(part.lower() for part in _SPLIT_RE.split(text) if part)

    tokens = name_tokens(name)
    if not tokens:
        return ()
    joined = tokens.replace(" ", "")
    hits: List[str] = []
    for category, pattern in _NAME_RULES:
        if pattern.search(tokens) or pattern.search(joined):
            hits.append(category)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(hits))

def classify_strings(strings: Iterable[Tuple[int, str]], limit_per_group: int = 6) -> Tuple[StringHit, ...]:
    """Categorised high-signal strings (``(address, text)`` pairs in, addressed hits out)."""
    counts: Dict[Tuple[str, str], int] = {}
    output: List[StringHit] = []
    for address, text in strings:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or len(text) < 4:
            continue
        lowered = text.lower()
        for category, group, needles in _STRING_RULES:
            key = (category, group)
            if counts.get(key, 0) >= limit_per_group:
                continue
            if any(needle in lowered for needle in needles):
                counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
                output.append(StringHit(category, group, address, text if len(text) <= 120 else text[:117] + "..."))

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LibraryHit:
    library: str
    category: str
    label: str
    strong: bool
    functions: int


def classify_libraries(libraries: Sequence[Tuple[str, int]]) -> Tuple[LibraryHit, ...]:
    output: List[LibraryHit] = []
    for library, count in libraries:
        lowered = library.lower()
        for needle, category, label, strong in _LIBRARY_RULES:
            if needle in lowered:
                output.append(LibraryHit(library, category, label, strong, count))
                break
    return tuple(output)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NameHit:

    name: str

def author_name_hits(functions: Iterable[object], is_author) -> Tuple[NameHit, ...]:
    """Name-derived behaviour of every author function (``is_author(summary) -> bool``)."""
    output: List[NameHit] = []
    for item in functions:
        if not is_author(item):
            continue
        name = str(getattr(item, "name", "") or "")
        categories = classify_name(name)
        if categories:
            output.append(NameHit(int(getattr(item, "address", 0)), name, categories))
    return tuple(output)


def group_name_hits(hits: Sequence[NameHit]) -> Dict[str, List[NameHit]]:
    grouped: Dict[str, List[NameHit]] = {}
    for hit in hits:
        for category in hit.categories:
            grouped.setdefault(category, []).append(hit)
    return grouped

    entries = [InventoryEntry(0x401000 + i * 0x40, n, is_library=lib_flags.get(n, False), callees=tuple(callees.get(n, ()))) for i, n in enumerate(names)]

                                     imports_called=(), string_count=0, is_library=e.is_library, origin=o.origin, package=o.package))
    return BinaryOverview(

        segments=tuple(SegmentInfo(n, 0x400000 + i * 0x100000, 0x400000 + (i + 1) * 0x100000, i == 0, False, True) for i, n in enumerate(segments)),

"""Token-metering wrapper around any ``LLMProvider``.

Every ``generate`` call is forwarded unchanged; afterwards the request
(prompt plus system instruction) and the response text are charged to a
``TokenBudget``. Real usage numbers carried by ``LLMResponse.usage`` win over
the four-characters-per-token estimate. The wrapper never alters, retries or
logs request content; only token counts reach the log.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable, Iterator, Optional, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.budget import TokenBudget, UsageRecord
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.logging import log_event
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.llm.base import LLMProvider, LLMRequest, LLMResponse, ProviderHealth


def request_text(request: LLMRequest) -> str:
    """The text that is charged for a request: prompt plus system instruction."""
    return (request.system_instruction or "") + request.prompt


class MeteredProvider(LLMProvider):
    """Forwarding provider that records token usage into a budget."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        inner: LLMProvider,
        budget: TokenBudget,
        on_record: Optional[Callable[[UsageRecord], None]] = None,
        logger=None,
        label: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        self.inner = inner
        self.budget = budget
        self._on_record = on_record
        self._logger = logger
        self._label = label
        self.last_record: Optional[UsageRecord] = None

    def generate(self, request: LLMRequest) -> LLMResponse:
        response = self.inner.generate(request)
        record = self.budget.charge(request_text(request), response.text, getattr(response, "usage", None))
        self.last_record = record
        if self._logger is not None:
            log_event(
                self._logger,
                "llm_usage",
                action=self._label or "-",
                input_tokens=record.input_tokens,
                output_tokens=record.output_tokens,
                estimated=record.estimated,
                session_total=self.budget.used,
            )
        if self._on_record is not None:
            self._on_record(record)
        return response

    def generate_with_tools(self, request: LLMRequest, tools: object) -> LLMResponse:
        return self.inner.generate_with_tools(request, tools)

    def stream(self, request: LLMRequest) -> Iterator[str]:
        return self.inner.stream(request)

    def health_check(self) -> ProviderHealth:
        return self.inner.health_check()

    def list_models(self) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.inner.list_models()


__all__ = ["MeteredProvider", "request_text"]

893	    returns ``None`` for a function that no longer exists. ``budget`` is charged

914	        if budget.exhausted:
915	            reason = "budget"
916	            break
917	        contexts: Dict[int, FunctionAnalysisContext] = {}
918	        for item in batch.items:
919	            try:
920	                context = collect_context(item.address, item.level)
921	            except Exception as exc:  # IDA read failed; the function is skipped, never the sweep
922	                context = None
923	                uncertainties.append("0x{0:X}: context collection failed ({1})".format(item.address, type(exc).__name__))
924	            if context is None:
925	                uncertainties.append("0x{0:X}: no context available; skipped".format(item.address))

934	            reason = "budget"

938	            reason = "cancelled"

950	        batches_done += 1

960	            findings.append(result)
961	            for capability in result.capabilities:
962	                if capability.strong:
963	                    strong[capability.category] = strong.get(capability.category, 0) + 1

969	            analysed=len(findings),
970	            batches_done=batches_done,
971	            requests=requests,
972	            tokens_used=budget.used - start_tokens,
973	            strong_by_category=dict(strong),
974	            score=score,

976	            findings=tuple(findings),
977	            concrete_by_category=dict(concrete),

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepSummary:
    functions_planned: int
    functions_analysed: int
    batches: int
    requests: int
    tokens_used: int
    stopped_reason: str
    pruned_noise_count: int

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "functions_planned": self.functions_planned,
            "functions_analysed": self.functions_analysed,
            "batches": self.batches,
            "requests": self.requests,
            "tokens_used": self.tokens_used,
            "stopped_reason": self.stopped_reason,
            "pruned_noise_count": self.pruned_noise_count,
        }


def format_sweep_summary(summary: SweepSummary) -> str:
    """``Sweep: 7/24 functions in 4 requests, ~18.2k tokens, stopped early: confident``."""
    text = "Sweep: {0}/{1} functions in {2} request{3}, {4}".format(
        summary.functions_analysed,
        summary.functions_planned,
        summary.requests,
        "" if summary.requests == 1 else "s",
        format_tokens(summary.tokens_used),
    )
    if summary.stopped_reason == "complete":
        text += ", completed"
    elif summary.stopped_reason == "cancelled":
        text += ", cancelled"
    else:
        text += ", stopped early: " + summary.stopped_reason
    if summary.pruned_noise_count:
        text += " ({0} noise function{1} pruned)".format(summary.pruned_noise_count, "" if summary.pruned_noise_count == 1 else "s")
    return text


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepResult:
    plan: SweepPlan
    functions: Tuple[SweepFunctionResult, ...]
    state: SweepState
    summary: SweepSummary
    uncertainties: Tuple[str, ...]
    trace: Tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def stopped_reason(self) -> str:
        return self.summary.stopped_reason


def _initial_state(plan: SweepPlan, budget: TokenBudget, base_score: int) -> SweepState:
    return SweepState(
        planned=plan.functions_planned,
        analysed=0,
        batches_done=0,
        requests=0,
        tokens_used=budget.used,
        strong_by_category={},
        score=max(0, min(100, int(base_score))),
        band=band_for(base_score),
    )


def run_sweep(
    plan: SweepPlan,
    collect_context: Callable[[int, str], Optional[FunctionAnalysisContext]],
    provider: LLMProvider,
    system_prompt: str,
    budget: TokenBudget,
    early_stop: Optional[Callable[[SweepState], Optional[str]]] = None,
    cancelled: Callable[[], bool] = lambda: False,
    progress: Callable[[str], None] = lambda text: None,
    max_output_tokens: int = 2048,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
    base_score: int = 0,
    base_categories: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset(),
) -> SweepResult:
    """Execute the plan batch by batch; never raises for a model problem (it records an uncertainty instead).

    ``collect_context(address, level)`` runs on IDA's thread in the plugin and
    returns ``None`` for a function that no longer exists. ``budget`` is charged
    per request unless ``provider`` is a ``MeteredProvider`` bound to that same
    budget (then the provider already charged it).
    """
    stop_policy = early_stop if early_stop is not None else default_early_stop
    start_tokens = budget.used
    state = _initial_state(plan, budget, base_score)
    strong: Dict[str, int] = {}
    concrete: Dict[str, int] = {}
    findings: List[SweepFunctionResult] = []
    uncertainties: List[str] = []
    trace: List[str] = []
    reason = "complete"
    requests = 0
    batches_done = 0
    provider_meters_budget = getattr(provider, "budget", None) is budget

    for batch in plan.batches:
        if cancelled():
            reason = "cancelled"
            break
        if budget.exhausted:
            reason = "budget"
            break
        contexts: Dict[int, FunctionAnalysisContext] = {}
        for item in batch.items:
            try:
                context = collect_context(item.address, item.level)
            except Exception as exc:  # IDA read failed; the function is skipped, never the sweep
                context = None
                uncertainties.append("0x{0:X}: context collection failed ({1})".format(item.address, type(exc).__name__))
            if context is None:
                uncertainties.append("0x{0:X}: no context available; skipped".format(item.address))
                continue
            contexts[item.address] = context
        if not contexts:
            batches_done += 1
            continue
        request = build_sweep_request(batch, contexts, system_prompt, max_output_tokens, temperature)
        request_text = (request.system_instruction or "") + request.prompt
        if not budget.reserve_ok(request_text):
            reason = "budget"
            uncertainties.append("batch {0} skipped: the token budget would be exceeded".format(batch.order))
            break
        if cancelled():
            reason = "cancelled"
            break
        try:
            response = provider.generate(request)
        except Exception as exc:  # provider failure: record and continue with the next batch
            requests += 1
            batches_done += 1
            uncertainties.append("batch {0}: model request failed ({1})".format(batch.order, _text(str(exc), 200) or type(exc).__name__))
            if not provider_meters_budget:
                budget.charge(request_text, "")
            continue
        requests += 1
        batches_done += 1
        if not provider_meters_budget:
            budget.charge(request_text, response.text, getattr(response, "usage", None))
        try:
            results, batch_uncertainties = parse_sweep_response(response.text, batch, contexts)
        except SweepResponseError as exc:
            uncertainties.append("batch {0}: {1}".format(batch.order, exc))
            results, batch_uncertainties = [], []
        uncertainties.extend(batch_uncertainties)
        for result in results:
            findings.append(result)
            for capability in result.capabilities:
                if capability.strong:
                    strong[capability.category] = strong.get(capability.category, 0) + 1
                if capability.concrete:
                    concrete[capability.category] = concrete.get(capability.category, 0) + 1
        score = signal_score(strong, base_score, base_categories)
        state = SweepState(
            planned=plan.functions_planned,
            analysed=len(findings),
            batches_done=batches_done,
            requests=requests,
            tokens_used=budget.used - start_tokens,
            strong_by_category=dict(strong),
            score=score,
            band=band_for(score),
            findings=tuple(findings),
            concrete_by_category=dict(concrete),
        )
        line = "batch {0}/{1}: {2} function(s) analysed, {3} so far, band {4}".format(
            batch.order, len(plan.batches), len(results), format_tokens(state.tokens_used), state.band.label
        )
        trace.append(line)
        progress(line)
        verdict = stop_policy(state)
        if verdict:
            reason = str(verdict)
            break
        if budget.exhausted:
            reason = "budget"
            break
    else:
        reason = "complete"

    summary = SweepSummary(
        functions_planned=plan.functions_planned,
        functions_analysed=len(findings),
        batches=batches_done,
        requests=requests,
        tokens_used=budget.used - start_tokens,
        stopped_reason=reason,
        pruned_noise_count=plan.pruned_noise_count,
    )
    state = replace(state, tokens_used=summary.tokens_used, findings=tuple(findings))
    trace.append(format_sweep_summary(summary))
    return SweepResult(
        plan=plan,
        functions=tuple(findings),
        state=state,
        summary=summary,
        uncertainties=tuple(dict.fromkeys(uncertainties)),
        trace=tuple(trace),
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Synthesis
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #


def sweep_root(result: SweepResult) -> Tuple[int, str]:
    if result.functions:
        return result.functions[0].address, result.functions[0].name
    if result.plan.items:
        return result.plan.items[0].address, result.plan.items[0].name
    return 0, "(binary)"


def build_sweep_facts(result: SweepResult, request: str = "Investigate the binary (top-ranked functions sweep)") -> SessionFacts:
    """``SessionFacts`` from the sweep: visited functions, edges, strings, model indicators as decoded hints."""
    root_address, root_name = sweep_root(result)
    functions: List[VisitedFunction] = []
    edges: List[Tuple[int, str, int, str]] = []
    edge_keys: Set[Tuple[int, int]] = set()
    strings: List[Tuple[Optional[int], str]] = []
    decoded: List[Tuple[Optional[int], str]] = []
    imports: List[str] = []
    names: Dict[int, str] = {}
    for item in result.functions:
        names[item.address] = item.name
    for item in result.functions:
        functions.append(VisitedFunction(item.address, item.name, item.size, _text(item.analysis.summary, 300)))
        for callee, callee_name in item.callees:
            key = (item.address, callee)
            if key not in edge_keys:
                edge_keys.add(key)
                edges.append((item.address, item.name, callee, names.get(callee, callee_name)))
        for caller, caller_name in item.callers:
            key = (caller, item.address)
            if key not in edge_keys:
                edge_keys.add(key)
                edges.append((caller, names.get(caller, caller_name), item.address, item.name))
        for text in item.strings:
            if (item.address, text) not in strings:
                strings.append((item.address, text))
        for api in item.analysis.important_apis:
            if api not in imports:
                imports.append(api)
        for kind, value in item.indicators:
            # Model-suggested indicators are re-extracted deterministically from their text.
            if (item.address, value) not in decoded and (item.address, value) not in strings:
                decoded.append((item.address, value))
    truncated = ["plan truncated at {0} functions".format(result.plan.max_functions)] if result.plan.truncated else []
    return SessionFacts(
        root_address=root_address,
        root_name=root_name,
        request=request,
        functions=tuple(functions[:200]),
        edges=tuple(edges[:1000]),
        strings=tuple(strings[:2000]),
        decoded=tuple(decoded[:200]),
        resolved_apis=(),
        imports=tuple(imports[:200]),
        proposals=(),
        tool_failures=0,
        truncated=tuple(truncated),
    )


def synthesize_sweep(
    result: SweepResult,
    provider: Optional[LLMProvider],
    system_prompt: str,
    max_output_tokens: int = 2048,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
) -> InvestigationResult:
    """ONE synthesis call over the sweep facts (attack chain, guided path, IOCs) via analysis/investigation.py."""
    facts = build_sweep_facts(result)
    root_analysis = result.functions[0].analysis if result.functions else None
    extra = list(result.uncertainties)
    if result.summary.stopped_reason not in ("complete",):
        extra.append("sweep stopped early: {0} ({1}/{2} functions analysed)".format(
            result.summary.stopped_reason, result.summary.functions_analysed, result.summary.functions_planned
        ))
    return synthesize_from_facts(
        facts,
        root_analysis,
        provider,
        system_prompt,
        max_output_tokens=max_output_tokens,
        temperature=temperature,
        trace=result.trace,
        extra_uncertainties=extra,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepReport:
    """What the ``sweep`` action delivers to the panel."""

    investigation: InvestigationResult
    summary: SweepSummary
    functions: Tuple[SweepFunctionResult, ...]
    trace: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    merged: bool = False


__all__ = [
    "CATEGORY_WEIGHT_KEY",

796	def _sample_metadata(path: Optional[str], triage: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict:
797	    file_type = triage.get("file_type") or "Unknown"
798	    architecture = triage.get("architecture") or "Unknown"
799	    meta = {"File type": str(file_type), "Architecture": str(architecture), "File size": "Unavailable",
800	            "Entry point": "Unavailable", "SHA256": "Unavailable", "Digital signature": "Unknown"}
801	    if not path:
802	        return meta
803	    try:
804	        target = Path(path)
805	        size = target.stat().st_size
806	        meta["File size"] = "{0} bytes".format(size)
807	        digest = hashlib.sha256()
808	        with target.open("rb") as handle:
809	            for block in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
810	                digest.update(block)
811	        meta["SHA256"] = digest.hexdigest()
812	        with target.open("rb") as handle:
813	            header = handle.read(4096)
814	        pe = _pe_metadata(header)
815	        if pe:
816	            meta["Entry point"] = "RVA {0} / VA {1}".format(_hex(pe["rva"]), _hex(pe["image_base"] + pe["rva"]))
817	            meta["Digital signature"] = "Signed (certificate present; validity not verified)" if pe["signed"] else "Unsigned"
818	            if str(file_type).lower() == "unknown":
819	                meta["File type"] = "PE32+ EXE" if pe["is_64"] else "PE32 EXE"
820	            if str(architecture).lower() == "unknown":
821	                meta["Architecture"] = "x64" if pe["is_64"] else "x86"
822	        return meta
823	    except (OSError, ValueError, struct.error):
824	        return meta

827	def _pe_metadata(data: bytes) -> Optional[dict]:
828	    if len(data) < 64 or data[:2] != b"MZ":
829	        return None
830	    pe_offset = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
831	    if pe_offset + 24 > len(data) or data[pe_offset:pe_offset + 4] != b"PE\0\0":
832	        return None
833	    optional = pe_offset + 24
834	    magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, optional)[0]
835	    is_64 = magic == 0x20B
836	    if magic not in (0x10B, 0x20B):
837	        return None
838	    entry_rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, optional + 16)[0]
839	    image_base = struct.unpack_from("<Q" if is_64 else "<I", data, optional + (24 if is_64 else 28))[0]
840	    directory_count_offset = optional + (108 if is_64 else 92)
841	    directory_offset = optional + (112 if is_64 else 96)
842	    signed = False
843	    if directory_count_offset + 4 <= len(data) and struct.unpack_from("<I", data, directory_count_offset)[0] > 4:
844	        certificate = directory_offset + 4 * 8
845	        if certificate + 8 <= len(data):
846	            signed = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, certificate) != (0, 0)
847	    return {"rva": entry_rva, "image_base": image_base, "signed": signed, "is_64": is_64}
