# The report is self-contained: it re-derives the whole-binary picture from IDA (local,
        # deterministic), selects the author functions that carry the most capability, reuses every
        # analysis already stored in the local database and sends only the rest to the model.
        binary_name, directory = self._run_on_ida_thread(self._report_directory, "MFF_READ")
        sample_path = self._run_on_ida_thread(self._input_file_path, "MFF_READ")
        overview, stats = self._run_on_ida_thread(self._collect_binary, "MFF_READ")
        if overview is None:
            return "IDA database is unavailable"
        outcome, seed = self._build_triage(overview, stats)
        origin_index = getattr(overview, "origin_index", None)
        triage_meta = {"file_type": overview.file_type, "architecture": outcome.report.architecture_label}
        del overview, stats
        self._last_triage = seed
        generated_at = time.time()
        notes = options.get("notes")
        config = self._config
        target = Path(directory) / report_module.default_report_filename(binary_name, generated_at)
        has_ai = self._has_ai_access()
        provider = self._metered(self._provider_factory(), "report") if has_ai else None
        store = self._analysis_store()
        budget = TokenBudget(config.sweep_token_budget)
        plan = plan_sweep(
            seed.ranked, seed.flows, seed.path, seed.adjacency, lambda address: address in seed.noise,
            REPORT_MAX_FUNCTIONS, budget, names=seed.names, instruction_counts=seed.instruction_counts,
            entries=seed.entries, batch_token_budget=config.sweep_batch_tokens,
        )
        sizes = {item.address: item.size for item in seed.functions}
        reused: List[Any] = []
        if store is not None:
            stored = {record.address: record for record in store.functions((full_report_module.STORE_KIND,))}
            for item in plan.items:
                record = stored.get(item.address)
                if record is None:
                    continue
                expected = self._function_fingerprint(item.address, item.name, sizes.get(item.address, 0))
                if record.fingerprint and record.fingerprint != expected:
                    continue  # the function changed since it was analysed
                rebuilt = full_report_module.payload_to_sweep_function(record.payload)
                if rebuilt is not None:
                    reused.append(rebuilt)
        reused_addresses = {item.address for item in reused}
        missing_plan = full_report_module.without_items(plan, reused_addresses)
        sweep_prompt = synthesis_prompt = None
        if provider is not None:
            try:
                sweep_prompt = self._prompt(PROMPT_FILES["sweep"])
                synthesis_prompt = self._prompt(PROMPT_FILES["synthesis"])
            except RuntimeError:
                provider = None
        applied = tuple(
            "{0} {1} @ 0x{2:X}: {3} → {4}".format(entry.get("status", ""), entry.get("operation", ""), int(entry.get("address", 0) or 0),
                                                 _log_value(entry.get("old_value")), _log_value(entry.get("new_value")))
            for entry in self.audit_entries() if str(entry.get("status", "")).startswith("APPLIED")
        )
        extra: Dict[str, Any] = {"tokens_before": self._token_meter.used}
        cancelled = lambda: _task_cancelled(extra.get("task"))  # noqa: E731
        if provider is not None and missing_plan.items:
            self._panel_trace("Report: {0} author function(s) selected, {1} reused from the local database, {2} to analyse".format(
                plan.functions_planned, len(reused), missing_plan.functions_planned))

        def collect(address: int, level: str) -> Optional[FunctionAnalysisContext]:
            sections = SECTIONS_BY_LEVEL.get(level, SECTIONS_BY_LEVEL["compact"])
            return self._run_on_ida_thread(lambda: collect_function_context(address, sections=sections), "MFF_READ")

        def progress(line: str) -> None:
            if not cancelled():
                self._panel_trace_async("Report " + line)

        def work() -> ReportOutcome:
            functions: List[Any] = list(reused)
            uncertainties: List[str] = []
            investigation = None
            new_count = 0
            if provider is not None and sweep_prompt is not None:
                result = None
                if missing_plan.items:
                    result = run_sweep(
                        missing_plan, collect, provider, sweep_prompt, budget, early_stop=never_stop, cancelled=cancelled,
                        progress=progress, max_output_tokens=config.max_output_tokens, temperature=config.temperature,
                        base_score=seed.score, base_categories=seed.evidence_categories,
                    )
                    new_count = len(result.functions)
                    functions.extend(result.functions)
                    uncertainties.extend(result.uncertainties)
                    if store is not None:
                        for item in result.functions:
                            store.put_function(
                                item.address, full_report_module.STORE_KIND, item.name, item.analysis.summary,
                                full_report_module.sweep_function_to_payload(item),
                                fingerprint=self._function_fingerprint(item.address, item.name, sizes.get(item.address, item.size)),
                            )
                if cancelled():
                    raise RuntimeError("Report cancelled")
                if functions and synthesis_prompt is not None:
                    order = {item.address: index for index, item in enumerate(plan.items)}
                    functions.sort(key=lambda item: order.get(item.address, len(order)))
                    combined = _combined_sweep_result(plan, functions, result, uncertainties)
                    progress("synthesising attack chain and indicators")
                    investigation = synthesize_sweep(
                        combined, provider if not budget.exhausted else None, synthesis_prompt,
                        max_output_tokens=config.max_output_tokens, temperature=config.temperature,
                    )
            data = full_report_module.FullReportData(
                binary_name=binary_name,
                generated_at=generated_at,
                sample=report_module._sample_metadata(sample_path, triage_meta),
                verdict=outcome.verdict,
                triage=outcome.report,
                packing=outcome.packing,
                flows=outcome.flows,
                path=outcome.path,
                origin_index=origin_index,
                functions=tuple(functions),
                investigation=investigation,
                analysed_new=new_count,
                reused=len(reused),
                planned=plan.functions_planned,
                tokens_used=max(0, self._token_meter.used - int(extra.get("tokens_before", 0) or 0)),
                uncertainties=tuple(dict.fromkeys(uncertainties)),
                analyst_notes=notes if isinstance(notes, str) else "",
                applied_changes=applied,
                ai_summary=str(getattr(investigation, "summary", "") or "") if investigation is not None else "",
                model_used=provider is not None,
            )
            markdown = full_report_module.generate_full_report(data)
            saved = report_module.save_report(markdown, target)
            return ReportOutcome(str(saved), markdown)

        self._launch("report", work, None, None, on_success, on_error, started, extra)
        return "{0}: {1} author function(s), {2} reused from the local database…".format(
            ACTION_LABELS["report"], plan.functions_planned, len(reused)
        )

"""Offline checks for store/caching provider, report rendering, sweep selection and Findings formatter."""
import sys, tempfile, os, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, r"C:\Users\pandalabs\Desktop\ida_ai_malware_analyst_Gpt\ida_ai_malware_analyst")
import py_compile, glob
root = r"C:\Users\pandalabs\Desktop\ida_ai_malware_analyst_Gpt\ida_ai_malware_analyst\ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin"
bad = []
for f in glob.glob(root + r"\**\*.py", recursive=True):
    try:
        py_compile.compile(f, doraise=True, cfile=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "pyc_check.pyc"))
    except py_compile.PyCompileError as e:
        bad.append(str(e))
print("compile errors:", bad or "none")

FAIL = []
def check(c, m):
    print(("PASS " if c else "FAIL ") + m)
    if not c: FAIL.append(m)

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.core.store import AnalysisStore, CachingProvider
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.llm.base import LLMProvider, LLMRequest, LLMResponse, ProviderHealth

class Fake(LLMProvider):
    calls = 0
    def generate(self, request):
        Fake.calls += 1
        return LLMResponse(text='{"ok": %d}' % Fake.calls, model="fake", usage={"input": 10, "output": 5})
    def health_check(self):
        return ProviderHealth(True, "fake")

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / "x.ai_analysis.sqlite"
store = AnalysisStore(tmp, "abc123")
check(store.available, "store opens")
req = LLMRequest(prompt="analyse 0x401000", system_instruction="sys")
p1 = CachingProvider(Fake(), store, "analyze")
r1 = p1.generate(req); p1.commit()
p2 = CachingProvider(Fake(), store, "analyze")
r2 = p2.generate(req)
check(Fake.calls == 1 and r2.text == r1.text and r2.usage == {"input": 0, "output": 0}, "identical request replayed from DB with 0 tokens")
p3 = CachingProvider(Fake(), store, "analyze")
p3.generate(LLMRequest(prompt="analyse 0x401000 RENAMED", system_instruction="sys")); p3.discard()
p4 = CachingProvider(Fake(), store, "analyze")
p4.generate(LLMRequest(prompt="analyse 0x401000 RENAMED", system_instruction="sys"))
check(Fake.calls == 3, "discarded (failed action) response is not replayed; changed context misses")
store.put_function(0x401000, "function_analysis", "main.getChromeLogins", "Reads Chrome Login Data and decrypts passwords",
                   {"analysis": {"observed_behavior": ["opens Login Data"], "important_apis": ["CryptUnprotectData"]}})
found = store.find_functions("what does main.getChromeLogins do?")
check(len(found) == 1, "Ask lookup finds stored function by name")
check(len(store.find_functions("explain 0x401000")) == 1, "Ask lookup finds stored function by address")
check(store.counts()["functions"] == 1, "counts")
store.close()
store2 = AnalysisStore(tmp, "abc123")
check(store2.counts()["responses"] >= 1, "DB persists across sessions")
check(store2.clear() >= 2 and store2.counts() == {"responses": 0, "functions": 0}, "clear empties this binary's rows")

# --- sweep selection: greedy capability coverage ------------------------------
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.sweep import plan_sweep
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import FunctionScore
ranked = []
cats = [("credential_theft",), ("credential_theft",), ("credential_theft",), ("credential_theft",), ("injection",), ("persistence",),
        ("c2",), ("keylogging",), ("surveillance",), ("network",), ("file",), ("credential_theft",)]
for i, c in enumerate(cats):
    ranked.append(FunctionScore(address=0x1000 + i, name="f%d" % i, score=30 - i, reasons=(), categories=c, size=200))
plan = plan_sweep(ranked, (), (), {}, lambda a: False, 8, names={r.address: r.name for r in ranked})
chosen = {r.categories[0] for r in ranked if r.address in plan.addresses}
check(len(plan.items) == 8, "top-8 plan has 8 items")
check({"injection", "persistence", "c2", "keylogging", "surveillance"} <= chosen, "top-8 covers distinct capabilities (got %s)" % sorted(chosen))

# --- report rendering ----------------------------------------------------------
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis import full_report as fr
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.sweep import SweepFunctionResult, SweepCapability, SweepReport, SweepSummary
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.function import FunctionAnalysis
fa = FunctionAnalysis("Collects Chrome passwords. Uses DPAPI.", ("reads Login Data",), (), (), ("CryptUnprotectData",), (), (), ("0x401010 call",), 0.9, (), None)
sf = SweepFunctionResult(0x401000, "main.getChromeLogins", "full", 1, fa,
                         (SweepCapability("credential_access", "browser password theft", ("0x401010 CryptUnprotectData", "0x401020 Login Data"), 0.9, "observed"),),
                         (("url", "https://evil.example/gate"),), ("Login Data",), ((0x402000, "main.upload"),), (), 300)
payload = fr.sweep_function_to_payload(sf)
back = fr.payload_to_sweep_function(payload)
check(back == sf, "sweep result round-trips through the DB payload")

# reuse the verdict from the harness scenario
sys.argv = ["x"]
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tv", os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "test_verdict.py"))
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.verdict import compute_verdict
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import rank_functions
exec_ns = {}
src = open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "test_verdict.py"), encoding="utf-8").read().split("# --- 2.")[0]
exec(compile(src, "tv", "exec"), exec_ns)
verdict = exec_ns["v"]
data = fr.FullReportData(binary_name="F50AD55F.fil", generated_at=time.time(), sample={"SHA256": "ff7d...", "File size": "12940113 bytes"},
                         verdict=verdict, origin_index=exec_ns["idx"], functions=(sf,), analysed_new=0, reused=1, planned=1)
md = fr.generate_full_report(data)
for section in ("## 1. Verdict", "## 2. Sample Metadata", "## 3. Code Origin", "## 4. Ranked Findings", "## 5. Key Author Functions",
                "## 6. Execution Flow", "## 7. Indicators", "## 8. MITRE ATT&CK", "## 10. Alternative Hypotheses", "## 11. Limitations",
                "## 12. Recommended Next Steps", "## 13. Analysis Coverage"):
    check(section in md, "report has " + section)
check("MALWARE" in md and "Infostealer" in md, "report verdict section shows classification")
check("[CONFIRMED]" in md, "report tags confirmed findings")
check("T1555.003" in md, "report maps credential theft to ATT&CK")
open(os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "sample_report.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(md)
print("sample report written to", os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "sample_report.md"))

print("\n{0} failure(s)".format(len(FAIL) + len(bad)))
sys.exit(1 if FAIL or bad else 0)

"""The Analyze Binary result bundle: triage report, verdict, packing, call flows and analysis path.

Pure Python. The controller builds a ``BinaryTriageOutcome`` from the
overview (which is then discarded) and keeps a small ``SweepSeed`` so the
"Investigate top N" sweep can plan without touching IDA again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, FrozenSet, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.callflow import AnalysisStep, CallFlow, format_analysis_path, format_call_flows
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.packing import PackingAssessment, format_packing_assessment
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import FunctionScore, TriageReport, format_triage_report, triage_jump_targets
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.verdict import Verdict, VerdictBand, format_verdict


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepSeed:
    """Compact, IDA-free facts the binary sweep needs (kept after the overview is dropped)."""

    ranked: Tuple[FunctionScore, ...]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]
    band: VerdictBand
    score: int
    noise: FrozenSet[int]
    adjacency: Mapping[int, Tuple[int, ...]]
    names: Mapping[int, str]
    instruction_counts: Mapping[int, int]
    entries: Tuple[int, ...]
    evidence_categories: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset()
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment] = None
    # Compact all-function inventory retained only for the one-click binary
    # function-naming workflow; no assembly or pseudocode is kept here.
    functions: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
    functions_truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BinaryTriageOutcome:
    report: TriageReport
    verdict: Verdict
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]

    @property
    def high_interest(self):  # compatibility with code that read the TriageReport directly
        return self.report.high_interest

    @property
    def suspicious_imports(self):
        return self.report.suspicious_imports

    @property
    def ai_summary(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.report.ai_summary


def format_binary_triage(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> str:
    """Triage tab text: verdict, packing, the classic triage report, call flows, analysis path."""
    parts: List[str] = [format_verdict(outcome.verdict).rstrip()]
    if outcome.packing is not None:
        parts.append(format_packing_assessment(outcome.packing).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_triage_report(outcome.report).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_call_flows(outcome.flows).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_analysis_path(outcome.path).rstrip())
    return "\n\n".join(part for part in parts if part) + "\n"


def binary_triage_jump_targets(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str, str], ...]:
    """``(address, name, role)`` in display order: analysis path first, then triage ranking, de-duplicated."""
    seen = set()
    targets: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    for step in outcome.path:
        if step.address not in seen:
            seen.add(step.address)
            targets.append((step.address, step.name, step.estimated_role))
    for address, name in triage_jump_targets(outcome.report):
        if address not in seen:
            seen.add(address)
            targets.append((address, name, "high interest"))
    return tuple(targets)


def format_jump_label(index: int, address: int, name: str, role: str) -> str:
    """``N. name [0xADDR] — role`` as shown in the Triage jump list."""
    return "{0}. {1} [0x{2:X}] — {3}".format(index, name, address, role)


def verdict_to_dict(verdict: Verdict) -> dict:
    return {
        "score": verdict.score,
        "band": verdict.band.value,
        "band_label": verdict.band.label,
        "local_band": (verdict.local_band or verdict.band).value,
        "evidence": [item.format() for item in verdict.evidence],
        "mitigating": [item.format() for item in verdict.mitigating],
        "packing_indicators": list(verdict.packing_indicators),
        "library_ratio": verdict.library_ratio,
        "summary": verdict.summary,
        "model_band": verdict.model_band.value if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_band_label": verdict.model_band.label if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_rationale": verdict.model_rationale,
        "model_evidence": list(verdict.model_evidence),
        "model_disagreements": list(verdict.model_disagreements),
        "notes": list(verdict.notes),
    }


def analysis_path_to_list(path: Sequence[AnalysisStep]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "order": step.order,
            "address": "0x{0:X}".format(step.address),
            "name": step.name,
            "why": step.why,
            "look_for": list(step.look_for),
            "priority": step.priority,
            "estimated_role": step.estimated_role,
            "on_suspicious_flow": step.on_suspicious_flow,
            "score": step.score,
        }
        for step in path
    ]


def call_flows_to_list(flows: Sequence[CallFlow]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "target": "0x{0:X}".format(flow.target),
            "target_name": flow.target_name,
            "path": ["{0} [0x{1:X}]".format(name, address) for address, name in flow.path],
            "reasons": list(flow.reasons[:3]),
            "collapsed_noise": flow.collapsed_noise,
            "note": flow.note,
        }
        for flow in flows
    ]


__all__ = [
    "BinaryTriageOutcome",
    "SweepSeed",
    "analysis_path_to_list",
    "binary_triage_jump_targets",
    "call_flows_to_list",
    "format_binary_triage",
    "format_jump_label",
    "verdict_to_dict",
]

    behaviours = [item.description.split(":", 1)[0] for item in verdict.evidence if item.category.startswith("behaviour:")]
    capabilities = [item.category for item in verdict.evidence if not item.category.startswith("behaviour:") and item.category not in ("packing", "strings")]
    text = "{0}{1} with {2}% confidence (score {3}/100, {4} aggravating / {5} mitigating signals, {6} of {7} functions are author code).".format(
        verdict.classification or verdict.band.label,
        " / " + verdict.subtype if verdict.subtype else "",
        verdict.confidence,
        verdict.score,
        len(verdict.evidence),
        len(verdict.mitigating),
        verdict.author_function_count,
        function_count,
    )
    if behaviours or capabilities:
        text += " Key behaviour: " + ", ".join(list(dict.fromkeys(behaviours + capabilities))[:5]) + "."
    if verdict.packing_indicators:
        text += " Packing indicators present."
    if not verdict.evidence:
        text += " No indicators were observed; packed or run-time-resolved code is invisible to this pass."
    return text

"""The Analyze Binary result bundle: triage report, verdict, packing, call flows and analysis path.

Pure Python. The controller builds a ``BinaryTriageOutcome`` from the
overview (which is then discarded) and keeps a small ``SweepSeed`` so the
"Investigate top N" sweep can plan without touching IDA again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, FrozenSet, List, Mapping, Optional, Sequence, Tuple

from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.callflow import AnalysisStep, CallFlow, format_analysis_path, format_call_flows
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.packing import PackingAssessment, format_packing_assessment
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.triage import FunctionScore, TriageReport, format_triage_report, triage_jump_targets
from ida_ai_malware_analyst_plugin.analysis.verdict import Verdict, VerdictBand, format_verdict


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SweepSeed:
    """Compact, IDA-free facts the binary sweep needs (kept after the overview is dropped)."""

    ranked: Tuple[FunctionScore, ...]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]
    band: VerdictBand
    score: int
    noise: FrozenSet[int]
    adjacency: Mapping[int, Tuple[int, ...]]
    names: Mapping[int, str]
    instruction_counts: Mapping[int, int]
    entries: Tuple[int, ...]
    evidence_categories: FrozenSet[str] = frozenset()
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment] = None
    # Compact all-function inventory retained only for the one-click binary
    # function-naming workflow; no assembly or pseudocode is kept here.
    functions: Tuple[Any, ...] = ()
    functions_truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BinaryTriageOutcome:
    report: TriageReport
    verdict: Verdict
    packing: Optional[PackingAssessment]
    flows: Tuple[CallFlow, ...]
    path: Tuple[AnalysisStep, ...]

    @property
    def high_interest(self):  # compatibility with code that read the TriageReport directly
        return self.report.high_interest

    @property
    def suspicious_imports(self):
        return self.report.suspicious_imports

    @property
    def ai_summary(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.report.ai_summary


def format_binary_triage(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> str:
    """Triage tab text: verdict, packing, the classic triage report, call flows, analysis path."""
    parts: List[str] = [format_verdict(outcome.verdict).rstrip()]
    if outcome.packing is not None:
        parts.append(format_packing_assessment(outcome.packing).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_triage_report(outcome.report).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_call_flows(outcome.flows).rstrip())
    parts.append(format_analysis_path(outcome.path).rstrip())
    return "\n\n".join(part for part in parts if part) + "\n"


def binary_triage_jump_targets(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str, str], ...]:
    """``(address, name, role)`` in display order: analysis path first, then triage ranking, de-duplicated."""
    seen = set()
    targets: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    for step in outcome.path:
        if step.address not in seen:
            seen.add(step.address)
            targets.append((step.address, step.name, step.estimated_role))
    for address, name in triage_jump_targets(outcome.report):
        if address not in seen:
            seen.add(address)
            targets.append((address, name, "high interest"))
    return tuple(targets)


def format_jump_label(index: int, address: int, name: str, role: str) -> str:
    """``N. name [0xADDR] — role`` as shown in the Triage jump list."""
    return "{0}. {1} [0x{2:X}] — {3}".format(index, name, address, role)


def verdict_to_dict(verdict: Verdict) -> dict:
    return {
        "score": verdict.score,
        "band": verdict.band.value,
        "band_label": verdict.band.label,
        "local_band": (verdict.local_band or verdict.band).value,
        "evidence": [item.format() for item in verdict.evidence],
        "mitigating": [item.format() for item in verdict.mitigating],
        "packing_indicators": list(verdict.packing_indicators),
        "library_ratio": verdict.library_ratio,
        "summary": verdict.summary,
        "model_band": verdict.model_band.value if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_band_label": verdict.model_band.label if verdict.model_band is not None else None,
        "model_rationale": verdict.model_rationale,
        "model_evidence": list(verdict.model_evidence),
        "model_disagreements": list(verdict.model_disagreements),
        "notes": list(verdict.notes),
    }


def analysis_path_to_list(path: Sequence[AnalysisStep]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "order": step.order,
            "address": "0x{0:X}".format(step.address),
            "name": step.name,
            "why": step.why,
            "look_for": list(step.look_for),
            "priority": step.priority,
            "estimated_role": step.estimated_role,
            "on_suspicious_flow": step.on_suspicious_flow,
            "score": step.score,
        }
        for step in path
    ]


def call_flows_to_list(flows: Sequence[CallFlow]) -> List[dict]:
    return [
        {
            "target": "0x{0:X}".format(flow.target),
            "target_name": flow.target_name,
            "path": ["{0} [0x{1:X}]".format(name, address) for address, name in flow.path],
            "reasons": list(flow.reasons[:3]),
            "collapsed_noise": flow.collapsed_noise,
            "note": flow.note,
        }
        for flow in flows
    ]

]

        return self.report.suspicious_imports

    @property
    def ai_summary(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self.report.ai_summary


TRIAGE_TAB_FUNCTIONS = 10
TRIAGE_TAB_FLOWS = 5


def format_binary_triage(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> str:
    """Concise Triage tab text; each fact appears once.

    Verdict (classification, evidence, code origin), a one-line packing
    headline, the top author functions and the strongest call flows. The
    full analysis path lives in the jump list below the text, the complete
    write-up in the Report tab.
    """
    parts: List[str] = [format_verdict(outcome.verdict).rstrip()]
    packing = outcome.packing
    if packing is not None:
        likelihood = getattr(packing, "packed_likelihood", None)
        indicators = tuple(getattr(packing, "indicators", ()) or ())
        line = "Packing: {0}".format(likelihood if likelihood is not None else "n/a")
        if indicators:
            line += " — " + "; ".join(str(getattr(item, "description", item)) for item in indicators[:3])
        parts.append(line)
    top = tuple(outcome.report.high_interest[:TRIAGE_TAB_FUNCTIONS])
    if top:
        lines = ["Top author functions (double-click in the list below to jump):"]
        for item in top:
            reasons = "; ".join(item.reasons[:2])
            lines.append("  0x{0:X}  {1:<36} score {2:>3}  {3}".format(item.address, item.name[:36], item.score, reasons))
        parts.append("\n".join(lines))
    else:
        parts.append("Top author functions: none scored above zero.")
    flows = tuple(outcome.flows[:TRIAGE_TAB_FLOWS])
    if flows:
        lines = ["Suspicious call flows:"]
        for flow in flows:
            chain = " → ".join(name for _address, name in (flow.path or ((flow.target, flow.target_name),)))
            lines.append("  {0}  ({1})".format(chain, flow.reasons[0] if flow.reasons else flow.note or ""))
        parts.append("\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(part for part in parts if part) + "\n"


def binary_triage_jump_targets(outcome: BinaryTriageOutcome) -> Tuple[Tuple[int, str, str], ...]:
    """``(address, name, role)`` in display order: analysis path first, then triage ranking, de-duplicated."""
    seen = set()
    targets: List[Tuple[int, str, str]] = []
    for step in outcome.path:
        if step.address not in seen:
            seen.add(step.address)
            targets.append((step.address, step.name, step.estimated_role))
    for address, name in triage_jump_targets(outcome.report):
        if address not in seen:
            seen.add(address)

    """``N. name [0xADDR] — role`` as shown in the Triage jump list."""

    return {

        "band": verdict.band.value,
        "band_label": verdict.band.label,
        "local_band": (verdict.local_band or verdict.band).value,

        "mitigating": [item.format() for item in verdict.mitigating],

            "collapsed_noise": flow.collapsed_noise,
            "note": flow.note,

check(by["runtime.mallocgc0"].origin == "runtime" and by["fmt.Sprintf1"].origin == "stdlib" and by["github.com/gorilla/websocket.read3"].origin == "third_party", "library origins")
check(sum(1 for f in ov.functions if f.detailed) == 3000, "detailed budget respected (3000)")
check(ov.language == "go" and ov.total_function_count == len(names), "language go, totals exact")
check(is_noise_function(by["runtime.mallocgc0"]) and not is_noise_function(by["main.Steal"]), "noise = library, author never noise")
check(addr["main.main"] in entry_functions(ov), "main.main is an analysis root")

v = compute_verdict(ov, None, ranked)
print(v.headline)
check(v.classification == "MALWARE", "verdict MALWARE for Go stealer layout")
print("\n{0} failure(s)".format(len(FAIL)))
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)

# IDA AI Malware Analyst 1.5.0: changes

## Correct verdicts for Go, Rust, Delphi, Nim and C/C++ (wrong "legitimate" for Go malware)

Root causes in 1.4.0:

1. **Collection cap in address order.** `TriageLimits.max_functions = 5000` and `collect_binary_overview` stopped at the first 5,000 functions by address. Go, Rust and Delphi place the runtime and standard library first and the author's code last. On a 10,000-function Go stealer, the verdict never saw `main.*`.
2. **MSVC-only library filter.** Noise detection only knew CRT names, so `runtime.*`, `core::*`, `System::*` and similar were treated as application code.
3. **Benign bias for static runtimes.** `high_library_ratio` (-15) rewarded every statically linked binary.
4. **Capabilities scored from the IAT only.** Go calls Windows through its own runtime, so its IAT shows nothing. Meanwhile its baseline runtime imports (LoadLibrary, GetProcAddress, SetThreadContext and so on) produced false capability hits.

Fixes:

- **New `analysis/code_origin.py`:**
  - Detects the language (Go, Rust, Delphi, Nim, .NET, C/C++).
  - Classifies every function as author, runtime, stdlib, third-party, compiler or thunk, by name with IDA flags and string hints.
  - Builds a whole-IDB origin table.
  - Safety rules so application code is never skipped:
    - Unknown functions are always treated as author code.
    - Unnamed helpers count as library only when every caller is a name-recognised static library (never CRT, runtime or FLIRT-only code), so a stripped `main` is never hidden.
    - Go modules that `main` calls directly, and that aren't well-known libraries, count as application code (e.g. `github.com/<org>/<implant>`).
    - Library-located functions with malicious-behaviour names are kept for analysis.
- **`ida/triage_data.py`:** inventories *all* functions (up to 250k) cheaply, then spends the detailed-summary budget on author code first. Every summary carries `origin` and `package`.
- **New `analysis/behaviour.py`:** behaviour signals that work without an IAT:
  - author function names (stealer, RAT, keylogger, ransomware, loader, PUP and so on)
  - high-signal strings (browser stores, wallets, ransom notes, C2 frameworks, browser-hijack keys)
  - capability libraries (Go modules, Rust crates)
- **`analysis/verdict.py`:**
  - Language-aware: runtime baseline APIs are ignored, there's no library-ratio benign bias for static runtimes, and the dynamic-resolution and import-starvation rules are skipped where they're normal.
  - Corroborated behaviour evidence, plus score floors for multi-source malware.
  - PUP band handling.
  - New `classification` (MALWARE / PUP/PUA / SUSPICIOUS-INCONCLUSIVE / LEGITIMATE), `subtype` and `confidence`.
- **`analysis/triage.py`:** non-author code is never ranked as interesting (-40). Author functions with behaviour names are ranked up.

## Investigate top N
- Picks the N functions that **together cover the most capability** (greedy coverage over a 120-function candidate pool), not the first N a depth-first walk reaches.
- Results now appear in the **Findings** tab as a concise conclusion: the capabilities found, then one line per function. Chain, path and IOCs stay in the Investigation tab, with no duplicated summary lines.

## Report tab (independent and structured)
- A new **Report** tab. The report no longer depends on what other tabs left in the history. It re-derives the verdict locally, selects the top author functions, analyses their decompiled code and synthesises the attack chain.
- The structure follows a manual analyst report:
  1. Verdict (classification, subtype, confidence)
  2. Metadata
  3. Code origin
  4. Ranked findings ([CONFIRMED]/[INFERRED]/[HYPOTHESIS] with addresses)
  5. Key author functions
  6. Execution flow
  7. IOCs (defanged)
  8. ATT&CK
  9. Packing
  10. Alternative hypotheses
  11. Limitations
  12. Next steps
  13. Coverage

## Local analysis database (`core/store.py`)
- `<idb>.ai_analysis.sqlite` next to the IDB, keyed by the input file's SHA-256. Uses only the standard-library `sqlite3`.
- **Response cache for every tab:** identical requests (same function context, same prompt) are replayed locally at 0 tokens. A renamed, retyped or patched function changes the request and is re-analysed. Responses are stored only after the action succeeded.
- **Function records:** every function analysis, sweep analysis or capability result is stored. Report reuses them, and Ask AI answers "what does `<function>` do?" from the database without tokens (prefix `!` to force the model).
- **Clear Cache** clears memory and the database rows of the current binary.

## Proposed Changes
- The list shows only proposals **awaiting a decision**. Approved, rejected and failed items leave immediately; their record stays in History/Audit.
- **Show applied changes (for rollback)** reveals applied items when needed.
- A new suggestion for the same function supersedes the older pending one, so repeated naming passes don't stack.

## Function naming (binary)
- Only application code is sent (never runtime, stdlib, third-party or compiler code), most interesting first.
- Output is a one-line summary plus the queued names. When nothing is queued, it says why: already pending, not writable, or the model declined for lack of evidence.

## Less verbose tabs
- **Triage:** verdict (evidence listed once), a one-line conclusion, the code-origin table, a packing headline, the top 10 author functions and the top 5 call flows. The full path is in the jump list; the full write-up is in Report.

content.text:
Binary Triage is fully deterministic, and that's its strength: it's free, repeatable and runs in seconds. Its weakness is that it only sees what IDA already labelled: imports, IDA's own string list and function names. The biggest wins come from making it recover more facts on its own, still without a model. Ranked by impact on verdict accuracy:

**High impact**
1. **Recover Go and Rust string literals.** Their strings aren't NUL-terminated, so IDA's string list misses most of them. For Go malware, that's where the C2 URLs, browser paths and commands live. A pass that finds string literals by how the code loads them (address plus length) would feed the verdict, the behaviour checks and the IOC list. I'd expect this to be the single biggest improvement for Go malware verdicts.
2. **Detect side-loading DLLs.** Three of your ten samples (0784, 6BDF, BD0A) were side-loaded DLLs, and each pattern can be checked statically:
   - many exports that all point to one stub
   - an internal export name that doesn't match the file name
   - exports that jump into a high-entropy section
   - a DllMain that patches the host's entry code
   - known side-load target names (`version.dll`, `graphics-hook-filter64.dll` and similar)
3. **Detect embedded payloads and wrappers.** Look for a PE inside resources or the overlay, recognise Inno, NSIS, AutoIt, PyInstaller, Nuitka and .NET, and flag high-entropy blobs with identical prefixes. The verdict would then say "installer, extract first" or ".NET, use dnSpy" instead of judging the stub.
4. **Use signature and version info as real evidence.** Today there's no signer data at all. Parse the Authenticode signer, version info and timestamps. That gives the legitimate verdict a real mitigating signal, and catches mismatches such as "NVIDIA" in the version info with no signature.

**Medium impact**
5. **Decode strings automatically.** The plugin already has deterministic decoders (XOR, RC4, base64, stack strings). Run them on the top 10 author functions during triage. Decoded strings are local facts, so this stays deterministic and token-free.
6. **Resolve API hashes.** Match hash-like constants in author code against ROR13, CRC32, DJB2 and FNV hashes of the API catalogue. That turns "dynamic resolution suspected" into "resolves VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory" with addresses.
7. **Scan for crypto constants per function** (AES S-box, RC4 key schedule, ChaCha, TEA delta, CRC tables). The decryptor function then gets a name and a role in the ranking.
8. **Detect anti-analysis instructions:** debugger-flag reads, `rdtsc` timing, the `cpuid` hypervisor bit, `int 2d`. These are concrete evasion evidence instead of keyword hits.

**Presentation**
9. **Click-to-jump evidence.** Every "Why" line already carries addresses; make them clickable in the jump list. Also show a confidence breakdown (names / strings / libraries / APIs) so you can see what drove the number.
10. **Show what changed between runs** after renames or unpacking ("new evidence: …"), and cache triage results in the new local database.
11. **Optional YARA (if `yara-python` is installed)** and a small table of known family markers (Winos `FaCai2024`, Sliver protobuf names and so on), reported as hints rather than verdicts. This keeps the plugin free of required dependencies.

My recommendation is to do 1–4 first. They address the exact gaps that caused misses or weak verdicts on your recent samples, and none of them needs a model. Want me to implement them?

# Data model

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SectionFact:
    name: str
    virtual_address: int
    virtual_size: int
    raw_offset: int
    raw_size: int
    executable: bool
    writable: bool
    entropy: float


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExportFact:
    name: str
    ordinal: int
    rva: int
    forwarded: Optional[str] = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResourceFact:
    type_name: str
    name: str
    language: int
    offset: int
    size: int
    entropy: float
    magic: bytes
    embedded_pe: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StaticFinding:
    """One deterministic observation for the verdict / Triage tab."""

    category: str  # side_loading | masquerade | embedded_payload | wrapper | signature | info
    description: str
    weight: int = 0
    location: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PeFacts:
    path: str
    file_size: int
    is_pe: bool
    is_dll: bool = False
    is_64: bool = False
    machine: int = 0
    timestamp: int = 0
    entry_rva: int = 0
    entry_section: str = ""
    image_base: int = 0
    sections: Tuple[SectionFact, ...] = ()
    exports: Tuple[ExportFact, ...] = ()
    export_dll_name: str = ""
    resources: Tuple[ResourceFact, ...] = ()
    version_info: Tuple[Tuple[str, str], ...] = ()
    signed: bool = False
    signer: str = ""
    signer_issuer: str = ""
    overlay_offset: int = 0
    overlay_size: int = 0
    overlay_entropy: float = 0.0
    overlay_magic: bytes = b""
    is_dotnet: bool = False
    has_tls: bool = False
    has_rich_header: bool = False
    wrappers: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    embedded_executables: Tuple[str, ...] = ()
    errors: Tuple[str, ...] = ()

    def version(self, key: str) -> str:
        for name, value in self.version_info:
            if name == key:
                return value
        return ""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parsing
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def entropy(data: bytes) -> float:
    if not data:
        return 0.0
    counts = Counter(data)
    total = float(len(data))
    return round(-sum(count / total * math.log2(count / total) for count in counts.values()), 3)


def parse_pe_file(path: Optional[str]) -> Optional[PeFacts]:
    """Facts for the file at ``path``; ``None`` when it cannot be read at all."""
    if not path:
        return None
    try:
        target = Path(path)
        size = target.stat().st_size
        with target.open("rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read(min(size, MAX_FILE_BYTES))
    except OSError:
        return None
    return parse_pe_bytes(data, str(path), size)


def parse_pe_bytes(data: bytes, path: str = "", file_size: Optional[int] = None) -> PeFacts:
    size = file_size if file_size is not None else len(data)
    errors: List[str] = []
    if len(data) < 0x40 or data[:2] != b"MZ":
        return PeFacts(path=path, file_size=size, is_pe=False, wrappers=_wrappers(data, None, ()), errors=("not a PE file",))
    try:
        pe_offset = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, 0x3C)[0]
        if pe_offset + 24 > len(data) or data[pe_offset:pe_offset + 4] != b"PE\0\0":
            return PeFacts(path=path, file_size=size, is_pe=False, errors=("invalid PE signature",))
        machine, section_count, timestamp = struct.unpack_from("<HHI", data, pe_offset + 4)
        optional_size, characteristics = struct.unpack_from("<HH", data, pe_offset + 20)
        optional = pe_offset + 24
        magic = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, optional)[0]
        is_64 = magic == 0x20B
        entry_rva = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, optional + 16)[0]
        image_base = struct.unpack_from("<Q" if is_64 else "<I", data, optional + (24 if is_64 else 28))[0]
        count_offset = optional + (108 if is_64 else 92)
        directory_offset = optional + (112 if is_64 else 96)
        directory_count = min(16, struct.unpack_from("<I", data, count_offset)[0]) if count_offset + 4 <= len(data) else 0
        directories: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
        for index in range(directory_count):
            start = directory_offset + index * 8
            directories.append(struct.unpack_from("<II", data, start) if start + 8 <= len(data) else (0, 0))
        while len(directories) < 16:
            directories.append((0, 0))
    except struct.error:
        return PeFacts(path=path, file_size=size, is_pe=False, errors=("truncated PE header",))

    sections: List[SectionFact] = []
    table = optional + optional_size
    for index in range(min(section_count, 96)):
        start = table + index * 40
        if start + 40 > len(data):
            errors.append("section table truncated")
            break
        raw_name = data[start:start + 8].split(b"\0", 1)[0]
        vsize, va, raw_size, raw_ptr = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", data, start + 8)
        flags = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, start + 36)[0]
        sample = data[raw_ptr:raw_ptr + min(raw_size, 4 * 1024 * 1024)] if raw_ptr < len(data) else b""
        sections.append(
            SectionFact(
                name=raw_name.decode("utf-8", "replace"),
                virtual_address=va,
                virtual_size=vsize,
                raw_offset=raw_ptr,
                raw_size=raw_size,
                executable=bool(flags & 0x20000000) or bool(flags & 0x20),
                writable=bool(flags & 0x80000000),
                entropy=entropy(sample),
            )
        )

    def rva_to_offset(rva: int) -> Optional[int]:
        for section in sections:
            span = max(section.virtual_size, section.raw_size)
            if section.virtual_address <= rva < section.virtual_address + span:
                offset = rva - section.virtual_address + section.raw_offset
                return offset if offset < len(data) else None
        return rva if rva < min(len(data), 0x1000) else None

    entry_section = next(
        (section.name for section in sections if section.virtual_address <= entry_rva < section.virtual_address + max(section.virtual_size, section.raw_size)),
        "",
    )
    exports, export_name = _exports(data, directories[0], rva_to_offset, errors)
    resources = _resources(data, directories[2], rva_to_offset, errors)
    version_info = _version_info(data, resources)
    signed, signer, issuer = _signature(data, directories[4])

    section_end = max((section.raw_offset + section.raw_size for section in sections if section.raw_size), default=0)
    cert_offset, cert_size = directories[4]
    overlay_end = cert_offset if signed and cert_offset >= section_end else size
    overlay_size = max(0, overlay_end - section_end) if section_end else 0
    overlay_data = data[section_end:section_end + min(overlay_size, 16 * 1024 * 1024)] if overlay_size else b""
    embedded: List[str] = []
    for resource in resources:
        if resource.embedded_pe:
            embedded.append("resource {0}/{1} ({2} bytes)".format(resource.type_name, resource.name, resource.size))
    if overlay_data:
        position = _find_embedded_pe(overlay_data)
        if position is not None:
            embedded.append("overlay +0x{0:X} (file offset 0x{1:X})".format(position, section_end + position))
    rich = b"Rich" in data[0x40:pe_offset]
    facts = PeFacts(
        path=path,
        file_size=size,
        is_pe=True,
        is_dll=bool(characteristics & 0x2000),
        is_64=is_64,
        machine=machine,
        timestamp=timestamp,
        entry_rva=entry_rva,
        entry_section=entry_section,
        image_base=image_base,
        sections=tuple(sections),
        exports=tuple(exports),
        export_dll_name=export_name,
        resources=tuple(resources),
        version_info=tuple(version_info),
        signed=signed,
        signer=signer,
        signer_issuer=issuer,
        overlay_offset=section_end if overlay_size else 0,
        overlay_size=overlay_size,
        overlay_entropy=entropy(overlay_data[: 4 * 1024 * 1024]) if overlay_data else 0.0,
        overlay_magic=overlay_data[:8],
        is_dotnet=directories[14][0] != 0,
        has_tls=directories[9][0] != 0,
        has_rich_header=rich,
        embedded_executables=tuple(embedded),
        errors=tuple(errors),
    )
    return _with_wrappers(facts, data, overlay_data)


def _exports(data: bytes, directory: Tuple[int, int], rva_to_offset, errors: List[str]) -> Tuple[List[ExportFact], str]:
    rva, size = directory
    if not rva:
        return [], ""
    offset = rva_to_offset(rva)
    if offset is None or offset + 40 > len(data):
        errors.append("export directory unreadable")
        return [], ""
    try:
        name_rva, base, function_count, name_count, functions_rva, names_rva, ordinals_rva = struct.unpack_from("<IIIIIII", data, offset + 12)
        dll_name = _c_string(data, rva_to_offset(name_rva))
        functions_offset = rva_to_offset(functions_rva)
        names_offset = rva_to_offset(names_rva)
        ordinals_offset = rva_to_offset(ordinals_rva)
        if functions_offset is None:
            return [], dll_name
        function_rvas = [struct.unpack_from("<I", data, functions_offset + 4 * index)[0] for index in range(min(function_count, MAX_EXPORTS))
                         if functions_offset + 4 * index + 4 <= len(data)]
        named: Dict[int, str] = {}
        if names_offset is not None and ordinals_offset is not None:
            for index in range(min(name_count, MAX_EXPORTS)):
                if names_offset + 4 * index + 4 > len(data) or ordinals_offset + 2 * index + 2 > len(data):
                    break
                entry_name = _c_string(data, rva_to_offset(struct.unpack_from("<I", data, names_offset + 4 * index)[0]))
                ordinal_index = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, ordinals_offset + 2 * index)[0]
                named[ordinal_index] = entry_name
        exports: List[ExportFact] = []
        for index, function_rva in enumerate(function_rvas):
            if not function_rva:
                continue
            forwarded = None
            if rva <= function_rva < rva + size:
                forwarded = _c_string(data, rva_to_offset(function_rva))
            exports.append(ExportFact(named.get(index, "#{0}".format(base + index)), base + index, function_rva, forwarded))
        return exports, dll_name
    except struct.error:
        errors.append("export directory truncated")
        return [], ""


def _c_string(data: bytes, offset: Optional[int], limit: int = 512) -> str:
    if offset is None or offset >= len(data):
        return ""
    end = data.find(b"\0", offset, offset + limit)
    raw = data[offset:end if end >= 0 else offset + limit]
    return raw.decode("ascii", "replace")


def _resources(data: bytes, directory: Tuple[int, int], rva_to_offset, errors: List[str]) -> List[ResourceFact]:
    rva, _size = directory
    if not rva:
        return []
    base = rva_to_offset(rva)
    if base is None:
        errors.append("resource directory unreadable")
        return []
    output: List[ResourceFact] = []

    def entry_label(raw: int, is_type: bool) -> str:
        if raw & 0x80000000:
            offset = base + (raw & 0x7FFFFFFF)
            if offset + 2 > len(data):
                return "?"
            length = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, offset)[0]
            return data[offset + 2:offset + 2 + 2 * min(length, 128)].decode("utf-16-le", "replace")
        return RESOURCE_TYPES.get(raw, str(raw)) if is_type else str(raw)

    def walk(offset: int, depth: int, path: Tuple[str, ...], seen: set) -> None:
        if depth > 3 or offset in seen or offset + 16 > len(data) or len(output) >= MAX_RESOURCES:
            return
        seen.add(offset)
        named, ids = struct.unpack_from("<HH", data, offset + 12)
        for index in range(min(named + ids, 256)):
            entry = offset + 16 + index * 8
            if entry + 8 > len(data):
                return
            raw_name, raw_offset = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, entry)
            label = entry_label(raw_name, depth == 0)
            if raw_offset & 0x80000000:
                walk(base + (raw_offset & 0x7FFFFFFF), depth + 1, path + (label,), seen)
                continue
            leaf = base + raw_offset
            if leaf + 16 > len(data):
                continue
            data_rva, data_size = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, leaf)
            file_offset = rva_to_offset(data_rva)
            if file_offset is None:
                continue
            blob = data[file_offset:file_offset + min(data_size, RESOURCE_SAMPLE)]
            type_name = path[0] if path else label
            name = path[1] if len(path) > 1 else label
            language = int(label) if label.isdigit() else 0
            output.append(ResourceFact(type_name, name, language, file_offset, data_size, entropy(blob), blob[:16], _is_pe(blob)))

    try:
        walk(base, 0, (), set())
    except struct.error:
        errors.append("resource tree truncated")
    return output


def _is_pe(blob: bytes) -> bool:
    if len(blob) < 0x40 or blob[:2] != b"MZ":
        return False
    pe = struct.unpack_from("<I", blob, 0x3C)[0]
    return pe + 4 <= len(blob) and blob[pe:pe + 4] == b"PE\0\0"


def _find_embedded_pe(blob: bytes) -> Optional[int]:
    start = 0
    for _ in range(64):
        position = blob.find(b"MZ", start)
        if position < 0:
            return None
        if _is_pe(blob[position:position + 4096]):
            return position
        start = position + 2
    return None


def _version_info(data: bytes, resources: Sequence[ResourceFact]) -> List[Tuple[str, str]]:
    output: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
    for resource in resources:
        if resource.type_name != "RT_VERSION":
            continue
        blob = data[resource.offset:resource.offset + min(resource.size, 64 * 1024)]
        for key in VERSION_KEYS:
            needle = key.encode("utf-16-le") + b"\0\0"
            position = blob.find(needle)
            if position < 0:
                continue
            cursor = position + len(needle)
            cursor += (-(resource.offset + cursor)) % 4  # values are 32-bit aligned
            end = cursor
            while end + 1 < len(blob) and blob[end:end + 2] != b"\0\0":
                end += 2
            value = blob[cursor:end].decode("utf-16-le", "replace").strip()
            if value:
                output.append((key, value[:200]))
        break
    return output


_DER_STRING_TAGS = (0x0C, 0x13, 0x14, 0x16, 0x1E)


def _signature(data: bytes, directory: Tuple[int, int]) -> Tuple[bool, str, str]:
    offset, size = directory
    if not offset or not size or offset + 8 > len(data):
        return False, "", ""
    blob = data[offset + 8:offset + min(size, 256 * 1024)]
    common: List[str] = []
    organisations: List[str] = []
    for oid, sink in ((b"\x06\x03\x55\x04\x03", common), (b"\x06\x03\x55\x04\x0a", organisations)):
        start = 0
        while len(sink) < 32:
            position = blob.find(oid, start)
            if position < 0:
                break
            cursor = position + len(oid)
            if cursor + 2 <= len(blob) and blob[cursor] in _DER_STRING_TAGS:
                length = blob[cursor + 1]
                if length < 0x80:
                    raw = blob[cursor + 2:cursor + 2 + length]
                    text = raw.decode("utf-16-be", "replace") if blob[cursor] == 0x1E else raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    if text and text not in sink:
                        sink.append(text)
            start = position + 1
    leaf = next((name for name in common if not any(word in name.lower() for word in _CA_WORDS)), "")
    issuer = next((name for name in common if name != leaf and any(word in name.lower() for word in ("ca", "code signing", "verified"))), "")
    org = next((name for name in organisations if not any(word in name.lower() for word in _CA_WORDS)), "")
    signer = leaf or org
    if org and leaf and org != leaf:
        signer = "{0} ({1})".format(leaf, org)
    return True, signer, issuer

def _wrappers(data: bytes, overlay: Optional[bytes], sections: Sequence[SectionFact]) -> Tuple[str, ...]:
    found: List[str] = []
    head = data[: 8 * 1024 * 1024]
    tail = data[-8 * 1024 * 1024:] if len(data) > 8 * 1024 * 1024 else b""
    for label, markers, _hint in _WRAPPER_MARKERS:
        if any(marker in head or (tail and marker in tail) for marker in markers):
            found.append(label)
    names = {section.name.lower() for section in sections}
    if {"upx0", "upx1"} & names and "UPX packed" not in found:
        found.append("UPX packed")
    if overlay:
        for magic, label in _OVERLAY_ARCHIVES:
            if overlay.startswith(magic) and label not in found:
                found.append(label)
    return tuple(found)


def _with_wrappers(facts: PeFacts, data: bytes, overlay: bytes) -> PeFacts:
    wrappers = list(_wrappers(data, overlay, facts.sections))
    if facts.is_dotnet:
        wrappers.insert(0, ".NET assembly")
    from dataclasses import replace

    return replace(facts, wrappers=tuple(dict.fromkeys(wrappers)))


def wrapper_hint(label: str) -> str:
    for name, _markers, hint in _WRAPPER_MARKERS:
        if name == label:
            return hint
    if label == ".NET assembly":
        return "IDA shows the native stub only; analyse the IL with dnSpy / ILSpy"
    if "archive" in label:
        return "extract the archive and analyse its contents"
    return ""

# Findings: side-loading, masquerade, payloads, signature
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _brand(text: str) -> str:
    lowered = (text or "").lower()
    for brand in VENDOR_BRANDS:
        if re.search(r"(?<![a-z]){0}".format(re.escape(brand)), lowered):
            return brand
    return ""


def static_findings(facts: Optional[PeFacts], dllmain_patches_host: bool = False) -> Tuple[StaticFinding, ...]:
    """Deterministic findings with verdict weights (0 = informational)."""
    if facts is None or not facts.is_pe:
        return ()
    output: List[StaticFinding] = []

    # --- signature ---------------------------------------------------------
    if facts.signed:
        output.append(StaticFinding("signature", "Authenticode signature present{0} (parsed, not verified)".format(
            ": " + facts.signer if facts.signer else ""), 0, "security directory"))
    claimed_brand = _brand(" ".join(value for key, value in facts.version_info if key in ("CompanyName", "ProductName", "FileDescription", "LegalCopyright")))
    export_brand = _brand(facts.export_dll_name)

    # --- side-loading -----------------------------------------------------
    sideload: List[str] = []
    if facts.is_dll and facts.exports:
        by_rva: Dict[int, List[str]] = {}
        for export in facts.exports:
            if export.forwarded is None:
                by_rva.setdefault(export.rva, []).append(export.name)
        shared = max(by_rva.values(), key=len) if by_rva else []
        if len(shared) >= 3:
            sideload.append("{0} exports share one entry stub ({1}, ...)".format(len(shared), ", ".join(shared[:3])))
        first_code = next((section for section in facts.sections if section.executable), None)
        for export in facts.exports:
            section = next((item for item in facts.sections if item.virtual_address <= export.rva < item.virtual_address + max(item.virtual_size, item.raw_size)), None)
            if section is not None and first_code is not None and section is not first_code and section.executable and section.entropy >= 7.0:
                sideload.append("export {0} points into high-entropy executable section {1} (entropy {2:.2f})".format(export.name, section.name, section.entropy))
                break
        if facts.export_dll_name.lower() in SIDELOAD_DLL_NAMES:
            sideload.append("internal DLL name {0} is a known side-loading target".format(facts.export_dll_name))
        elif export_brand and not facts.signed:
            sideload.append("unsigned DLL whose internal name {0} imitates a {1} component".format(facts.export_dll_name, export_brand))
        if any(export.forwarded for export in facts.exports) and len(facts.exports) > 3:
            forwarded = sum(1 for export in facts.exports if export.forwarded)
            sideload.append("{0} forwarded exports (proxy DLL pattern)".format(forwarded))
    if dllmain_patches_host:
        sideload.append("DllMain changes memory protection / writes code in the host module")
    if len(sideload) >= 2:
        output.append(StaticFinding("side_loading", "DLL side-loading / proxy indicators: " + "; ".join(sideload), 20, "export directory"))
    elif sideload:
        output.append(StaticFinding("info", "side-loading hint (uncorroborated): " + sideload[0], 0, "export directory"))

    # --- masquerade -------------------------------------------------------
    if claimed_brand and not facts.signed:
        output.append(StaticFinding("masquerade", "unsigned file claims to be from {0} in its version information ({1})".format(
            claimed_brand, facts.version("CompanyName") or facts.version("ProductName") or facts.version("FileDescription")), 8, "RT_VERSION"))

    # --- payloads ---------------------------------------------------------
    installer = any(label in facts.wrappers for label in ("Inno Setup installer", "NSIS installer", "7-Zip SFX archive", "RAR SFX archive", "CAB archive in overlay"))
    for item in facts.embedded_executables:
        output.append(StaticFinding("embedded_payload", "embedded executable in " + item, 0 if installer else 10, item))
    blobs = [resource for resource in facts.resources
             if resource.type_name not in _MEDIA_TYPES and resource.size >= 4096 and resource.entropy >= 7.5
             and not resource.magic.startswith(_MEDIA_MAGIC) and not resource.embedded_pe]
    prefixes: Dict[bytes, List[ResourceFact]] = {}
    for resource in blobs:
        prefixes.setdefault(resource.magic[:12], []).append(resource)
    for prefix, group in prefixes.items():
        if len(group) >= 2:
            output.append(StaticFinding("embedded_payload", "{0} high-entropy resources share the same first bytes ({1}): same key over the same header - likely encrypted payloads ({2})".format(
                len(group), prefix.hex(), ", ".join("{0}/{1}".format(item.type_name, item.name) for item in group[:4])), 0 if installer else 8, "resources"))
            break
    else:
        if blobs and not installer:
            largest = max(blobs, key=lambda item: item.size)
            output.append(StaticFinding("info", "high-entropy resource {0}/{1} ({2} bytes, entropy {3:.2f})".format(
                largest.type_name, largest.name, largest.size, largest.entropy), 0, "resources"))

    # --- wrappers (informational, they change what must be analysed) -----
    for label in facts.wrappers:
        hint = wrapper_hint(label)
        output.append(StaticFinding("wrapper", label + (" — " + hint if hint else ""), 0, "file"))
    if facts.overlay_size >= 1024 and not installer:
        output.append(StaticFinding("info", "overlay of {0} bytes at 0x{1:X} (entropy {2:.2f}, magic {3})".format(
            facts.overlay_size, facts.overlay_offset, facts.overlay_entropy, facts.overlay_magic[:4].hex()), 0, "overlay"))
    return tuple(output)


def format_static_facts(facts: Optional[PeFacts], findings: Sequence[StaticFinding]) -> str:
    """Compact Triage-tab block."""
    if facts is None:
        return "File facts: input file not available (IDB moved?) - signature, resource and overlay checks skipped."
    if not facts.is_pe:
        return "File facts: not a PE file ({0})".format("; ".join(facts.errors) or "unknown format")
    kind = "{0} {1}".format("PE32+" if facts.is_64 else "PE32", "DLL" if facts.is_dll else "EXE")
    signature = "signed by {0}".format(facts.signer or "unknown subject") if facts.signed else "unsigned"
    lines = ["File facts: {0}, {1:,} bytes, {2}{3}".format(kind, facts.file_size, signature, ", .NET" if facts.is_dotnet else "")]
    company = facts.version("CompanyName")
    product = facts.version("ProductName") or facts.version("FileDescription")
    original = facts.version("OriginalFilename")
    if company or product or original:
        lines.append("  version info: " + " | ".join(item for item in (company, product, original) if item))
    if facts.exports:
        lines.append("  exports: {0} ({1}){2}".format(
            len(facts.exports), ", ".join(export.name for export in facts.exports[:5]),
            "; internal name " + facts.export_dll_name if facts.export_dll_name else ""))
    for finding in findings:
        if finding.category == "signature":
            continue
        weight = " [+{0}]".format(finding.weight) if finding.weight > 0 else ""
        lines.append("  - {0}{1}".format(finding.description, weight))
    return "\n".join(lines)


__all__ = [
    "PeFacts", "StaticFinding", "format_static_facts", "parse_pe_bytes", "parse_pe_file", "static_findings", "wrapper_hint",
]
